Replicates the training-time split (train_HyenaTransgenic.py: manual_seed(123), random_split 75/10/15 over isoformDataHyena(db, exclude_prefix='Zm')), then runs de novo generation with the published 400M checkpoint on: - the 60,550 held-out test rows (9 training species, from fig3_test_rows.tsv) - all 49,431 Z. mays rows (entire genome withheld) Predictions are written per species as GFF3 (RC rows coordinate-flipped) for per-species GFFCompare evaluation (Fig. 3A) and per-gene metrics (Fig. 3C/D). Protocol matches the benchmark: beam search, num_beams=2, do_sample=False (deterministic), max_length=2048 (run_genome_annotation.py). """ import os, sys, csv, time, json sys.path.insert(0, "/home/framazan/transgenic/src") import torch import duckdb from collections import defaultdict from transformers import AutoModel, AutoTokenizer from transgenic.utils.gsf import gffString2GFF3 DB = "/home/framazan/data/Generation_10G_static6144_addExtra200_addRCIsoOnly_clean.db" TSV = "/home/framazan/fig3_test_rows.tsv" OUTDIR = "/home/framazan/fig3_test_preds_prompted" DONE = "/home/framazan/fig3_test_preds_prompted.done" MODEL = "jlomas/HyenaTransgenic-768L12A6-400M" ENC = "LongSafari/hyenadna-large-1m-seqlen-hf" BATCH = 4 SPECIES = [ ("AT", "A_thaliana"), ("Glyma", "G_max"), ("Pp", "P_patens"), ("Potri", "P_trichocarpa"), ("Sobic", "S_bicolor"), ("Bradi", "B_distachyon"), ("Seita", "S_italica"), ("Vitvi", "V_vinifera"), ("LOC_Os", "O_sativa"), ("Zm", "Z_mays"), ] # 361 gene models in the training DB carry no species prefix: MSU v7 places 185 # O. sativa genes on the ChrSy/ChrUn pseudo-molecules, and RefGen_V4 retains 176 # legacy GRMZM maize IDs. Both sets are present in the reference annotations used # for evaluation, so they belong here. EXTRA_PREFIX = [("ChrSy", "O_sativa"), ("ChrUn", "O_sativa"), ("GRMZM", "Z_mays")] UNASSIGNED = "_unassigned" os.makedirs(OUTDIR, exist_ok=True) device = torch.device("cuda") torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False try: torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest") except Exception: torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("high") torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = True print("loading model...", flush=True) model = AutoModel.from_pretrained(MODEL, trust_remote_code=True).eval().to(device) gffTok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL, trust_remote_code=True) dnaTok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(ENC, trust_remote_code=True) con = duckdb.connect(DB, config={"access_mode": "READ_ONLY"}) # ---- collect work items ----------------------------------------------------- rns = [] with open(TSV) as fh: r = csv.reader(fh, delimiter="\t") next(r) for row in r: rns.append(int(row[0])) zm = con.sql("SELECT rn FROM geneList WHERE geneModel LIKE 'Zm%' ORDER BY rn").fetchall() rns += [r[0] for r in zm] print(f"total rows: {len(rns)}", flush=True) done = set() if os.path.exists(DONE): done = {int(x) for x in open(DONE) if x.strip()} print(f"resume: {len(done)} rows already done", flush=True) rns = [r for r in rns if r not in done] # fetch metadata in chunks rows = {} B = 10000 for i in range(0, len(rns), B): chunk = rns[i:i+B] q = ("SELECT rn, geneModel, start, fin, strand, chromosome, sequence, gff " f"FROM geneList WHERE rn IN ({','.join(map(str, chunk))})") for rn, gm, st, fin, strand, ch, seq, gff in con.sql(q).fetchall(): rows[rn] = (gm, st, fin, strand, ch, seq, gff) # group by (seqlen) for padding-free batches bylen = defaultdict(list) for rn in rns: if rn in rows: bylen[len(rows[rn][5])].append(rn) batches = [] for L, group in sorted(bylen.items(), key=lambda kv: -len(kv[1])): for i in range(0, len(group), BATCH): batches.append(group[i:i+BATCH]) print(f"{len(batches)} batches", flush=True) out_fh = {sp: open(os.path.join(OUTDIR, f"{sp}_test400M.gff3"), "a") for _, sp in SPECIES} # Catch-all so an unrecognised prefix is reported and skipped rather than # aborting the run, as it did in the de novo pass on 2026-07-27. out_fh[UNASSIGNED] = open(os.path.join(OUTDIR, f"{UNASSIGNED}_test400M.gff3"), "a") done_fh = open(DONE, "a") # ---- prompt construction (mirrors prompt_mode.get_single_decoder_input_ids) -- t0 = time.time() n_done = 0 for bi, batch in enumerate(batches): seqs = [rows[rn][5] for rn in batch] toks = dnaTok(seqs, return_tensors="pt", padding=False) ii = toks["input_ids"][:, :-1].to(device) if toks["input_ids"].shape[1] > 1 else toks["input_ids"].to(device) am = (ii != dnaTok.pad_token_id) dii = batch_dii(batch) max_new = max(1, 2048 - dii.shape[1]) try: with torch.inference_mode(): outs = model.generate(inputs=ii, attention_mask=am, num_return_sequences=1, max_new_tokens=max_new, num_beams=2, do_sample=False, decoder_input_ids=dii, use_cache=True) except torch.cuda.OutOfMemoryError: torch.cuda.empty_cache() for rn in batch: # fall back to single-row generation seq = rows[rn][5] t1 = dnaTok(seq, return_tensors="pt") i1 = t1["input_ids"][:, :-1].to(device) a1 = (i1 != dnaTok.pad_token_id) d1 = batch_dii([rn]) with torch.inference_mode(): o1 = model.generate(inputs=i1, attention_mask=a1, num_return_sequences=1, max_new_tokens=max(1, 2048 - d1.shape[1]), num_beams=2, do_sample=False, decoder_input_ids=d1, use_cache=True) write_pred(rn, o1) n_done += len(batch) done_fh.flush() continue for j, rn in enumerate(batch): write_pred(rn, outs[j:j+1]) done_fh.flush() n_done += len(batch) if bi % 50 == 0: el = time.time() - t0 rate = n_done / el if el else 0 eta = (len(rns) - n_done) / rate / 3600 if rate else 0 print(f"[{bi}/{len(batches)}] {n_done}/{len(rns)} rows, {rate:.2f} rows/s, ETA {eta:.1f} h", flush=True) print("ALL DONE", flush=True)

nodes.name: species_of
nodes.body_text: def species_of(gm): for pref, sp in SPECIES + EXTRA_PREFIX: if gm.startswith(pref): return sp return None

nodes.name: flip_rc
nodes.body_text: def flip_rc(lines, fin): out = [] for ln in lines: if not ln or ln.startswith("#"): continue f = ln.split("\t") s, e = int(f[3]), int(f[4]) ns, ne = fin - e + 1, fin - s + 1 f[3], f[4] = str(ns), str(ne) f[6] = "+" if f[6] == "-" else "-" if f[6] == "+" else f[6] out.append("\t".join(f)) return out

nodes.name: write_pred
nodes.body_text:
def write_pred(rn, out_row): pred = gffTok.batch_decode(out_row.detach().cpu().numpy(), skip_special_tokens=True)[0] gm, st, fin, strand, ch, seq, _gff = rows[rn] lines = gffString2GFF3(pred, ch, st, f"GM={gm}") if gm.endswith("-rc"): lines = flip_rc(lines, fin) sp = species_of(gm) if sp is None: print(f"WARNING: no species prefix for gene model {gm!r} (rn {rn}); " f"writing to {UNASSIGNED}", flush=True) sp = UNASSIGNED if lines != [""]: out_fh[sp].write("
".join(lines) + "
") out_fh[sp].flush() done_fh.write(f"{rn}
")

nodes.name: first_transcript_ids
nodes.body_text: def first_transcript_ids(label_gsf): """Legacy 272-token prompt: features of the first transcript only.""" ids = [gffTok._convert_token_to_id(t) for t in gffTok._tokenize(label_gsf)] labs = ",".join(map(str, ids)) try: last_element = labs.split(",17,")[1].split(",21,")[0].split(",")[-1] last_element_index = [ f",{last_element}," in i for i in labs.split(",17,")[0].split(",21,") ].index(True) except (ValueError, IndexError): last_element_index = len(labs.split(",17,")[0].split(",21,")) - 1 first = ",21,".join(labs.split(",17,")[0].split(",21,")[0:last_element_index + 1]) return list(map(int, first.split(",")))

nodes.name: batch_dii
nodes.body_text: def batch_dii(rns_): START = model.config.decoder_start_token_id seqs_ = [] for rn in rns_: gff = rows[rn][6] ids = ([START] + first_transcript_ids(gff)[:2047]) if gff else [START] seqs_.append(ids) mx = max(len(s) for s in seqs_) return torch.tensor([s + [gffTok.pad_token_id or 1] * (mx - len(s)) for s in seqs_], device=device)

nodes.name: fig3_per_gene_metrics.py
nodes.body_text: #!/usr/bin/env python3 """Figure 3C/D regeneration: per-gene base-level F1 vs gene length and CDS count. For every test-set prediction (GM=<geneModel> in the prediction GFF3), compute base-level recall/precision/F1 against the corresponding reference gene model: recall = |pred_exonic ∩ ref_exonic| / |ref_exonic| precision = |pred_exonic ∩ ref_exonic| / |pred_exonic| Exonic bases = union of exon features (references) and union of CDS+UTR+exon features (predictions; predictions carry CDS/exon/UTR). Outputs: fig3_per_gene_metrics.csv (species,gene_model,gene_len,n_cds,recall,precision,f1) """ import re, sys, csv from collections import defaultdict from pathlib import Path GPFS = Path("/data/gpfs/assoc/pgl/data/Transgenic") GENOMES = GPFS / "genomes" PREDS = GPFS / "transgenic/revision/results/fig3_regen/preds" OUT = GPFS / "transgenic/revision/results/fig3_regen/fig3_per_gene_metrics.csv" REFS = { "A_thaliana": "Athaliana_167_TAIR10.gene.clean.gff3", "G_max": "Gmax_880_Wm82.a6.v1.gene_exons.clean.gff3", "P_patens": "Ppatens_318_v3.3.gene_exons.clean.gff3", "P_trichocarpa": "Ptrichocarpa_533_v4.1.gene_exons.clean.gff3", "S_bicolor": "Sbicolor_730_v5.1.gene_exons.clean.gff3", "B_distachyon": "Bdistachyon_314_v3.1.gene_exons.clean.gff3", "S_italica": "Sitalica_312_v2.2.gene_exons.clean.gff3", "V_vinifera": "Vvinifera_PN40024_5.1_on_T2T_ref.exon.gff3", "O_sativa": "Osativa_323_v7.0.gene_exons.exon.gff3", "Z_mays": "Zmays_493_RefGen_V4.gene_exons.exon.gff3", } # transcript->gene map needed for refs with mRNA between; handled via cur above (best effort) rows_out = [] for sp, refname in REFS.items(): pred_file = PREDS / f"{sp}_test400M.gff3" if not pred_file.exists(): print("skip", sp) continue ref = load_ref(GENOMES / refname) # predictions grouped by GM pred = defaultdict(list) for line in open(pred_file): if line.startswith("#"): continue f = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t") if len(f) < 9 or f[2] not in ("CDS", "exon", "five_prime_UTR", "three_prime_UTR"): continue m = re.search(r'GM=([^;]+)', f[8]) if not m: continue pred[(f[0], m.group(1))].append((int(f[3]), int(f[4]))) for (chrom, gm), iv in pred.items(): gm_base = gm.replace("-rc", "") if gm_base not in ref: continue chr_, gs, ge, rex, ncds = ref[gm_base] if chr_ != chrom or not rex: continue piv = merge(iv) ov = overlap_bp(piv, rex) rec = ov / span(rex) prec = ov / span(piv) if span(piv) else 0.0 f1 = 2 * rec * prec / (rec + prec) if rec + prec else 0.0 rows_out.append((sp, gm, ge - gs + 1, ncds, round(rec, 4), round(prec, 4), round(f1, 4))) print(sp, "done", flush=True) with open(OUT, "w", newline="") as fh: w = csv.writer(fh) w.writerow(["species", "gene_model", "gene_len", "n_cds", "recall", "precision", "f1"]) w.writerows(rows_out) print("wrote", OUT, len(rows_out), "rows")

nodes.name: merge
nodes.body_text: def merge(iv): iv = sorted(iv) out = [] for s, e in iv: if out and s <= out[-1][1]: out[-1][1] = max(out[-1][1], e) else: out.append([s, e]) return [(s, e) for s, e in out]

nodes.name: span
nodes.body_text: def span(iv): return sum(e - s + 1 for s, e in iv)

nodes.name: overlap_bp
nodes.body_text: def overlap_bp(a, b): i = j = tot = 0 while i < len(a) and j < len(b): s = max(a[i][0], b[j][0]); e = min(a[i][1], b[j][1]) if s <= e: tot += e - s + 1 if a[i][1] < b[j][1]: i += 1 else: j += 1 return tot

nodes.name: load_ref
nodes.body_text: def load_ref(path): """gene_id -> [chr, start, end, exon_iv, n_cds] (exons merged per gene)""" genes = {} tx2gene = {} for line in open(path): if line.startswith("#"): continue f = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t") if len(f) < 9: continue feat, s, e = f[2], int(f[3]), int(f[4]) attrs = f[8] m = re.search(r'ID=([^;]+)', attrs) mp = re.search(r'Parent=([^;]+)', attrs) if feat == "gene" and m: genes.setdefault(m.group(1), [f[0], s, e, [], 0]) elif feat in ("mRNA", "transcript") and m and mp: parent = mp.group(1) if parent in genes: tx2gene[m.group(1)] = parent elif feat in ("exon", "CDS") and mp: g = tx2gene.get(mp.group(1)) if g is None and mp.group(1) in genes: # direct gene parentage g = mp.group(1) if g is None: continue if feat == "exon": genes[g][3].append((s, e)) else: genes[g][4] += 1 genes[g][3].append((s, e)) for g, v in genes.items(): v[3] = merge(v[3]) return genes

nodes.name: fig3_split.py
nodes.body_text: import sys sys.path.insert(0, "/home/framazan/transgenic/src") import torch from transgenic.datasets.datasets import isoformDataHyena DB = "/home/framazan/data/Generation_10G_static6144_addExtra200_addRCIsoOnly_clean.db" torch.manual_seed(123) ds = isoformDataHyena(DB, mode="train", exclude_prefix="Zm") total = len(ds) train_size = int(total * 0.75) eval_size = int(total * 0.10) test_size = total - train_size - eval_size train_data, eval_data, test_data = torch.utils.data.random_split(ds, [train_size, eval_size, test_size]) print(f"total={total} train={train_size} eval={eval_size} test={test_size} | test.indices={len(test_data.indices)}") import duckdb, collections con = duckdb.connect(DB, config={"access_mode": "READ_ONLY"}) test_rns = sorted(ds._index_map[i] for i in test_data.indices) print("test_rns:", len(test_rns), "first/last:", test_rns[:3], test_rns[-3:]) # species distribution of test rows (by geneModel prefix heuristic via chromosome) import csv with open("/home/framazan/fig3_test_rows.tsv", "w") as out: w = csv.writer(out, delimiter="\t") w.writerow(["rn","geneModel","start","fin","strand","chromosome"]) # chunk the rn list to avoid huge SQL B = 5000 for i in range(0, len(test_rns), B): chunk = test_rns[i:i+B] q = f"SELECT rn, geneModel, start, fin, strand, chromosome FROM geneList WHERE rn IN ({','.join(map(str,chunk))})" for row in con.sql(q).fetchall(): w.writerow(row) # Z. mays rows (held out entirely) zm = con.sql("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM geneList WHERE geneModel LIKE 'Zm%'").fetchone()[0] print("Zm rows in db:", zm) cnt = collections.Counter() for rn in test_rns[:0]: pass con.close() print("WROTE /home/framazan/fig3_test_rows.tsv")

nodes.name: italicize_species.py
nodes.body_text: #!/usr/bin/env python3 """Italicize species names left in plain runs of a pandoc-built .docx (in place). Splits each affected run into plain / italic / plain runs; runs already italic are untouched.""" import re, sys, zipfile, shutil, os GENERA = {"Arabidopsis": ["thaliana", "lyrata", "halleri"], "Vitis": ["vinifera"], "Glycine": ["max"], "Populus": ["trichocarpa"], "Sorghum": ["bicolor"], "Brachypodium": ["distachyon"], "Setaria": ["italica", "viridis"], "Oryza": ["sativa"], "Physcomitrium": ["patens"], "Physcomitrella": ["patens"], "Zea": ["mays"], "Brassica": ["rapa"], "Lactuca": ["sativa"], "Solanum": ["lycopersicum"], "Drosophila": ["melanogaster"]} names = [] for g, sps in GENERA.items(): for s in sps: names += [rf"{g} {s}", rf"{g[0]}\. {s}"] names.append("Drosophila") SPECIES = re.compile(r"(?<![A-Za-z])(" + "|".join(sorted(names, key=len, reverse=True)) + r")(?![A-Za-z])") RUN = re.compile(r"<w:r(?: [^>]*)?>(.*?)</w:r>", re.S) RPR = re.compile(r"<w:rPr>(.*?)</w:rPr>", re.S) T = re.compile(r"<w:t(?: [^>]*)?>(.*?)</w:t>", re.S) rewrite.n = 0 path = sys.argv[1] tmp = path + ".tmp" with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as zin, zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout: for item in zin.infolist(): data = zin.read(item.filename) if item.filename == "word/document.xml": xml = data.decode("utf-8") xml = RUN.sub(rewrite, xml) left = sum(1 for r in RUN.finditer(xml) if not is_italic((RPR.search(r.group(1)) or [None, None])[1] if RPR.search(r.group(1)) else None) and SPECIES.search(re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", "", r.group(1)))) data = xml.encode("utf-8") zout.writestr(item, data) shutil.move(tmp, path) print(f"{os.path.basename(path)}: {rewrite.n} runs split; non-italic species runs remaining: {left}")

nodes.name: is_italic
nodes.body_text: def is_italic(rpr): return rpr is not None and re.search(r"<w:i(?:/>| )", rpr) is not None

nodes.name: rewrite
nodes.body_text: def rewrite(m): inner = m.group(1) rpr_m = RPR.search(inner); rpr = rpr_m.group(1) if rpr_m else None ts = T.findall(inner) rest = RPR.sub("", T.sub("", inner)).strip() if len(ts) != 1 or rest or is_italic(rpr) or not SPECIES.search(ts[0]): return m.group(0) plain_rpr = f"<w:rPr>{rpr}</w:rPr>" if rpr is not None else "" ital_rpr = f"<w:rPr><w:i/><w:iCs/>{rpr or ''}</w:rPr>" out = [] for i, seg in enumerate(SPECIES.split(ts[0])): if not seg: continue pr = ital_rpr if i % 2 == 1 else plain_rpr out.append(f'<w:r>{pr}<w:t xml:space="preserve">{seg}</w:t></w:r>') rewrite.n += 1 return "".join(out)

nodes.name: make_dataset_roles.py
nodes.body_text: #!/usr/bin/env python3 """Build evidence/DATASET_ROLES.tsv — the fail-closed role manifest of protocol A18.3 (issue #5). Every dataset AND every run gets exactly one role: b1_validation_only | c2_training_eligible | excluded. Builders (C0 ingestion, C2 label generation, B1 scorer) refuse any run that is not listed here, so this file has to be complete before the first alignment (protocol line 213: the matrix and this manifest are checksummed into §1 before the first alignment). Roles are not inferred from the directory a file happens to sit in. Two of them are deliberate exceptions that a directory-based rule would get wrong: - ont/Athaliana_cui2020_PRJNA594286 was fetched by the *validation* driver but is c2_training_eligible (A18.3), and is excluded from the A. thaliana B1 replication. - the PacBio tree under RETIRED_DO_NOT_USE/ is excluded by author decision of 2026-09-03 (issue #60): all 51 runs are _subreads, and protocol §3/v1.3/v1.5 admits PacBio only at CCS/FLNC level. Checksums, author decision of 2026-09-03. `source_checksum` is the **ENA-published fastq_md5**, which identifies the object at the source and is stable across re-downloads. The md5 our fetcher writes is a different thing — it hashes the FASTA we produced after `zcat | seqkit fq2fa | gzip`, so it changes between two downloads of identical data (gzip stores an mtime in its header; two fetches of Cui 2020 differ in file md5 and agree exactly once decompressed) and cannot be compared to anything the source publishes. That value is kept as `local_fa_md5`, which is what identifies the artifact we actually hold. Known limit, recorded rather than papered over: the fetcher streams the fastq and never stores it, so the ENA md5 documents what was fetched but cannot be re-verified against what we keep without downloading again. Verifying the stream at fetch time (tee to md5sum before zcat) is the fix and is not implemented. GenBank efetch publishes no per-batch checksum, so the EST rows carry authority `none`. """ import argparse import csv import shlex import subprocess import hashlib import json import os import re import sys ROOT_DEFAULT = "/data/gpfs/assoc/pgl/data/Transgenic/evidence" TRAINING_SPECIES = ("Athaliana", "Bdistachyon", "Gmax", "Osativa", "Ppatens", "Ptrichocarpa", "Sbicolor", "Sitalica", "Vvinifera") TEST_SPECIES = ("Zmays", "Slycopersicum") # A30 (frozen text): the Swiss-Prot resource is recorded "with the role sensitivity_set (a fourth # role value; builders still fail closed on unknown roles)". The tuple held three values, so the row # A30.5 step 1 tells this script to write was rejected by validate(). Unknown roles still fail. ROLES = ("b1_validation_only", "c2_training_eligible", "excluded", "sensitivity_set") # Genotype stratum per dataset. Not derivable from any field, so it is stated once, here, with the # reason. A18.4 gives it a weight: reference 1.0, non_reference / hybrid_pooled / unknown 0.5. GENOTYPE = { "est/Athaliana": ("reference", "GenBank gbdiv_est, predominantly Col-0; not resolvable per accession"), "ont/Athaliana_FLIC_PRJNA1087576": ("reference", "Col-0"), "ont/Athaliana_cui2020_PRJNA594286": ("reference", "Col-0 rosette"), "ont/Zmays_roottip_PRJNA822071": ("reference", "B73 root tip"), "ont/Slycopersicum_heinz_PRJEB37834": ("reference", "Heinz"), "pacbio/Athaliana_zhang2023_PRJNA911826": ("reference", "Col-0 WT runs only, mutants excluded at fetch"), "pacbio/Zmays_B73_ccs_PRJNA1470126": ("reference", "B73"), "pacbio/Zmays_kinnex_hybrid_PRJNA1290227": ("hybrid_pooled", "B73 x Mo17 hybrid; A7-P pooled stratum"), "pacbio/Zmays_wang2018_PRJEB22122": ("reference", "B73"), "pacbio/Zmays_wang2020_zenodo2611319": ("hybrid_pooled", "all-genotype FLNC; B73-only selection required by §3.1 before scoring"), "training/ont/Athaliana/cui2020_PRJNA594286": ("reference", "Col-0 rosette"), "training/ont/Athaliana/col0_DRP009401": ("reference", "Col-0 subset of PRJDB14952; C24 and F1 runs deliberately not taken"), "training/ont/Gmax/wm82_graft_PRJNA648759": ("reference", "Williams 82"), "training/ont/Gmax/wm82_seed_PRJNA416810": ("reference", "Williams 82"), "training/ont/Gmax/scn_roots_PRJNA803218": ("non_reference", "genotype 09-138"), "training/ont/Osativa/nip_dRNA_6tissue_PRJNA752930": ("reference", "Nipponbare"), "training/ont/Osativa/nip_pool_PRJNA953663": ("reference", "Nipponbare; mixed BioProject, WGS run rejected by the A18.3 strategy filter (#63)"), "training/ont/Osativa/nip_sheath_PRJNA1044249": ("reference", "Nipponbare sheath"), "training/ont/Osativa/indica_flagleaf_PRJNA1291274": ("non_reference", "indica SY63/MH63/ZS97"), "training/ont/Ppatens/dRNA_gametophore_PRJNA681088": ("reference", "Gransden gametophore"), "training/ont/Ptrichocarpa/sdx_dRNA_PRJNA517295": ("non_reference", "SDX genotype"), "training/ont/Ptrichocarpa/sdx_drought_PRJNA672182": ("non_reference", "SDX genotype"), "training/ont/Sitalica/ci846_salt_PRJNA1097621": ("non_reference", "Ci846"), "training/ont/Vvinifera/pinotnoir_berry_PRJNA776245": ("reference", "Pinot noir, the PN40024 background"), "training/ont/Vvinifera/callus_PRJNA732451": ("unknown", "callus line not stated"), } # A run that exists in two dataset paths must be declared here, naming which copy is canonical, or the # manifest refuses to build. A18.3's acceptance criterion is that every run occurs exactly once; a # duplicate that nobody noticed is the same evidence counted twice. Key: run accession -> canonical dataset. # 저자 결정 2026-09-03: 중복된 사본은 쓰지 않는다. 정본은 프로토콜 A18.3이 **이름으로 지목한** 경로 # ("ont/Athaliana_cui2020_PRJNA594286 … has role c2_training_eligible")이므로 그쪽을 남기고, 학습 # 드라이버가 따로 받은 사본은 role=excluded로 내린다. 두 사본은 압축을 풀면 완전히 동일하다(실측); # 파일 md5가 달랐던 것은 gzip 헤더의 타임스탬프 때문이다. DUPLICATE_RESOLUTION: dict = { "SRR10611193": "ont/Athaliana_cui2020_PRJNA594286", "SRR10611194": "ont/Athaliana_cui2020_PRJNA594286", "SRR10611195": "ont/Athaliana_cui2020_PRJNA594286", } DUPLICATE_BASIS = ("저자 결정 2026-09-03: 같은 런의 중복 사본은 쓰지 않는다. 정본은 프로토콜 A18.3이 " "이름으로 지목한 경로이며 내용은 두 사본이 동일하다") # Datasets whose role is not the default for their location, with the clause that sets it. ROLE_OVERRIDE = { "ont/Athaliana_cui2020_PRJNA594286": ("c2_training_eligible", "A18.3: fetched by the validation driver but training-eligible; " "excluded from the A. thaliana B1 replication"), } # Datasets that are not one-file-per-run. Zenodo 2611319 ships a single FLNC FASTA plus the paper's GFF, # marked flnc.DONE / gff.DONE, so the per-run walker cannot find a <run>.md5 for them. NON_RUN_DATASETS = { "pacbio/Zmays_wang2020_zenodo2611319": [ ("F1maize.flnc.fa.gz", "F1maize.flnc.md5", "FLNC"), ("F1maize.FINAL.gff", None, "reference_gff"), ("F1maize.demux_FL_count.txt", None, "demultiplex_counts"), ], } # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Non-run resources (issue #66, author decision 2026-09-03) # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Everything above is *scanned*: the builder walks the evidence tree and emits one row per # sequencing run. Two objects the protocol depends on are not runs and are not in that tree -- # the cross-species protein resource (A19/#44) and the Swiss-Prot sensitivity set (A30) -- so # they had no way into the manifest at all, and hand-editing the TSV does not survive the next # regeneration. They are *declared* here instead. # # Declared, but checkable: both files live on pgl-gpu, outside the tree this builder walks, so # they cannot be scanned into the manifest -- but that host is reachable over ssh, so the # declaration is verified rather than trusted. `--verify-resources` recomputes each md5 from the # file and refuses to write on a mismatch *or* on a file it could not read; without the flag the # run says so on stderr. A resource whose file changes without this table changing is exactly the # drift the manifest exists to catch, and now the check can see it. RESOURCE_DATA_TYPES = ("protein_resource", "sensitivity_resource") # Runs that A18.3 has to account for but the tree scan can never see, because they were never # collected. A tree scan can only distinguish "here" from "not here"; it cannot distinguish "never # considered" from "considered and rejected", and that distinction is the whole point of a scope # manifest. Recording the decision in prose (protocol §1, TRAINING_EVIDENCE_v1.md) left the run # with no role, which A18.3 forbids: every dataset AND every run carries exactly one role, and # `excluded` is one of them. # # These are declarations, never synthetic .DONE files or placeholder FASTAs. A fake marker would # make the run indistinguishable from collected evidence, which is the error this is fixing. DECLARED_RUNS = ( dict(dataset="training/ont/Osativa/nip_pool_PRJNA953663", run="SRR25203456", species="Osativa", genotype_stratum="reference", instrument="PromethION", data_type="RNA-Seq", expected_files="1", expected_reads="13195758", source_checksum="a8a59f575ff287efe951305edbedab27", source_checksum_authority="ENA_fastq_md5", local_fa_md5="", role="excluded", basis="author decision 2026-09-04, issue #68: ENA publishes this run's fastq path as a " "directory, so no resume or retry reaches a file; the NCBI mirror was verified " "reachable but an SRA fallback was not added to the frozen fetch driver and the run " "was dropped instead", note="DECLARED_NOT_SCANNED: never collected, so there is no local FASTA and no .DONE " "marker. Measured 2026-09-04: HEAD on the published fastq_ftp path 301-redirects to " "a trailing slash and the parent listing shows SRR25203456_1.fastq.gz/ as a " "directory. PRJNA953663 therefore contributes nothing"), ) RESOURCES = ( dict(dataset="protein/orthodb_v12_viridiplantae_stage2", run="odb12_Viridiplantae.filtered.fa.gz", species="cross_species", genotype_stratum="n/a", instrument="n/a", data_type="protein_resource", expected_files="1", expected_reads="12115085", source_checksum="", source_checksum_authority="none", local_fa_md5="453cb32b02e0799950d7d5f4de5f62ac", role="c2_training_eligible", basis="A19: cross-species protein resource for C2 CDS-family labels; leakage filter A19.1", note="pgl-gpu /home/pgl/scratch1/wyim/transgenic_data/orthodb_filtered_stage2/; " "12,115,085 of 12,204,762 sequences over 408 taxa; zero sequences from the evaluated " "species (taxids 3702/4577/4081), removed in stage 1; 3,178,195,033 B; " "md5 recomputed from the file 2026-09-03 and re-verified live over ssh, matches " "filter_summary.json; " "frozen into protocol section 1 (issue #66)"), dict(dataset="protein/swissprot_plants_2026_02", run="uniprot_sprot_plants.dat.gz", species="cross_species", genotype_stratum="n/a", instrument="n/a", data_type="sensitivity_resource", expected_files="1", expected_reads="42096", source_checksum="", source_checksum_authority="none", local_fa_md5="552089d0642b6c17f3486140a73a0163", role="sensitivity_set", basis="A30: separately labelled sensitivity/audit set for start codon, stop codon and " "phase; never a label resource (A19 unchanged)", note="pgl-gpu /home/pgl/scratch1/wyim/transgenic_data/protein/; UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot " "Release 2026_02 of 10-Jun-2026; 44,909 entries, 42,096 Viridiplantae; 58,889,942 B; " "sha256 09116f0b9db67ecc47bd4393ca6a417f311c0c6499b4614a9f581c0f5ead092e; " "md5 recomputed from the file 2026-09-03, re-verified live over ssh"), ) # Where each declared resource actually lives, so the declaration can be checked rather than # trusted. The builder runs on pronghorn and the files sit on pgl-gpu, but that host is reachable # over ssh, so "the builder cannot see them" was a reason to write the check, not to skip it. RESOURCE_LOCATIONS = { "odb12_Viridiplantae.filtered.fa.gz": ("gpu", "/home/pgl/scratch1/wyim/transgenic_data/orthodb_filtered_stage2/" "odb12_Viridiplantae.filtered.fa.gz"), "uniprot_sprot_plants.dat.gz": ("gpu", "/home/pgl/scratch1/wyim/transgenic_data/protein/uniprot_sprot_plants.dat.gz"), } FIELDS = ["dataset", "run", "species", "genotype_stratum", "instrument", "data_type", "expected_files", "expected_reads", "source_checksum", "source_checksum_authority", "local_fa_md5", "role", "basis", "note"] if __name__ == "__main__": main()

nodes.name: md5
nodes.body_text: def md5(path): h = hashlib.md5() with open(path, "rb") as fh: for chunk in iter(lambda: fh.read(1 << 22), b""): h.update(chunk) return h.hexdigest()

nodes.name: read_md5_file
nodes.body_text: def read_md5_file(path): """<run>.md5 as written by longread_fetch.sh / est_fetch.sh: 'md5 filename'.""" try: with open(path) as fh: return fh.read().split()[0] except Exception: return ""

nodes.name: filereport
nodes.body_text: def filereport(dataset_dir): """run_accession -> (instrument_model, library_strategy, read_count, fastq_md5) from the ENA filereport.""" out = {} p = os.path.join(dataset_dir, "filereport.tsv") if not os.path.exists(p): return out with open(p) as fh: for r in csv.DictReader(fh, delimiter="\t"): out[r.get("run_accession", "")] = (r.get("instrument_model", ""), r.get("library_strategy", ""), r.get("read_count", ""), r.get("fastq_md5", "")) return out

nodes.name: species_of
nodes.body_text: def species_of(dataset_key, fallback=""): for sp in TRAINING_SPECIES + TEST_SPECIES: if re.search(rf"\b{sp}\b", dataset_key) or f"/{sp}/" in dataset_key or dataset_key.split("/")[-1].startswith(sp): return sp return fallback

nodes.name: rows_for_est
nodes.body_text: def rows_for_est(root): for sp in sorted(os.listdir(os.path.join(root, "est"))): d = os.path.join(root, "est", sp) fa = os.path.join(d, "est.fa.gz") if not os.path.isdir(d) or not os.path.exists(fa): continue key = f"est/{sp}" total = "" for name in ("COUNT", "TOTAL"): p = os.path.join(d, name) if os.path.exists(p): total = open(p).read().strip() break role = "b1_validation_only" if sp in TEST_SPECIES else "c2_training_eligible" gt, gt_note = GENOTYPE.get(key, ("unknown", "not stated")) yield dict(dataset=key, run="est.fa.gz", species=sp, genotype_stratum=gt, instrument="GenBank_EST", data_type="EST", expected_files="1", expected_reads=total, source_checksum="", source_checksum_authority="none", local_fa_md5=read_md5_file(fa + ".md5"), role=role, basis="A14: EST of the training species is training evidence; test-species EST is validation only", note=gt_note + "; GenBank efetch publishes no per-batch checksum")

nodes.name: rows_for_runs
nodes.signature: def rows_for_runs(root, rel, default_role, data_type, basis)
nodes.body_text: def rows_for_runs(root, rel, default_role, data_type, basis): base = os.path.join(root, rel) if not os.path.isdir(base): return for dirpath, _dirnames, filenames in os.walk(base): key = os.path.relpath(dirpath, root) if key in NON_RUN_DATASETS: gt, gt_note = GENOTYPE.get(key, ("unknown", "not stated")) role, note_extra = ROLE_OVERRIDE.get(key, (default_role, "")) for fname, md5file, kind in NON_RUN_DATASETS[key]: fp = os.path.join(dirpath, fname) if not os.path.exists(fp): continue ck = read_md5_file(os.path.join(dirpath, md5file)) if md5file else md5(fp) yield dict(dataset=key, run=fname, species=species_of(key), genotype_stratum=gt, instrument="Sequel", data_type=kind, expected_files="1", expected_reads="", source_checksum=ck, source_checksum_authority="Zenodo_published" if md5file else "local_only", local_fa_md5=ck, role=role, basis=note_extra or basis, note=gt_note) continue dones = sorted(f[:-5] for f in filenames if f.endswith(".DONE")) if not dones: continue meta = filereport(dirpath) role, note_extra = default_role, "" if key in ROLE_OVERRIDE: role, note_extra = ROLE_OVERRIDE[key] gt, gt_note = GENOTYPE.get(key, ("unknown", "not stated")) for run in dones: inst, strat, reads, ena_md5 = meta.get(run, ("", "", "", "")) yield dict(dataset=key, run=run, species=species_of(key), genotype_stratum=gt, instrument=inst or "unknown", data_type=strat or data_type, expected_files="1", expected_reads=reads, source_checksum=ena_md5, source_checksum_authority="ENA_fastq_md5" if ena_md5 else "none", local_fa_md5=read_md5_file(os.path.join(dirpath, run + ".md5")), role=role, basis=note_extra or basis, note=gt_note)

nodes.name: rows_for_declared_runs
nodes.body_text: def rows_for_declared_runs(): """Declared sequencing runs that are absent from the scanned evidence tree. Copies, so a caller cannot mutate the declaration.""" for r in DECLARED_RUNS: yield dict(r)

nodes.name: _ssh_md5
nodes.body_text: def _ssh_md5(host, path): """md5 of a remote file. Raises if the host or the file cannot be reached.""" out = subprocess.run(["ssh", "-o", "BatchMode=yes", host, f"md5sum -- {shlex.quote(path)}"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=1800) if out.returncode != 0 or not out.stdout.strip(): raise OSError((out.stderr or out.stdout).strip() or f"md5sum failed on {host}:{path}") return out.stdout.split()[0]

nodes.name: verify_resources
nodes.body_text: def verify_resources(runner=_ssh_md5): """Recompute every declared resource's md5 from the file and compare with the declaration. Fails closed in both directions that matter: a checksum that no longer matches, and a file we could not read at all. The second case is the subtle one -- a check that quietly passes when it could not look is worse than no check, because it converts 'unknown' into 'verified'. """ v = [] for r in RESOURCES: host, path = RESOURCE_LOCATIONS[r["run"]] try: got = runner(host, path) except Exception as e: # noqa: BLE001 - any failure to look is a failure v.append(f"{r['dataset']}: {host}:{path} could not be read ({e})") continue if got != r["local_fa_md5"]: v.append(f"{r['dataset']}: md5 mismatch at {host}:{path} " f"(declared {r['local_fa_md5']}, file has {got})") return v

nodes.name: rows_for_resources
nodes.body_text: def rows_for_resources(): """Declared non-run resources. Copies, so a caller cannot mutate the declaration.""" for r in RESOURCES: yield dict(r)

nodes.name: demote_duplicates
nodes.body_text: def demote_duplicates(rows): """중복 사본을 excluded로 내린다 — 매니페스트가 같은 증거를 두 번 세지 않게.""" n = 0 for r in rows: canonical = DUPLICATE_RESOLUTION.get(r["run"]) if canonical and r["dataset"] != canonical: r["role"] = "excluded" r["basis"] = DUPLICATE_BASIS + f" ({canonical})" n += 1 return n

nodes.name: build
nodes.body_text: def build(root): rows = [] rows += list(rows_for_est(root)) rows += list(rows_for_runs(root, "training/ont", "c2_training_eligible", "ONT", "A14: training-species ONT is training evidence")) rows += list(rows_for_runs(root, "ont", "b1_validation_only", "ONT", "A14: validation-only long reads")) rows += list(rows_for_runs(root, "pacbio", "b1_validation_only", "PacBio", "A14: test-species validation accepts any PacBio generation")) rows += list(rows_for_runs(root, "RETIRED_DO_NOT_USE", "excluded", "PacBio", "issue #60, author decision 2026-09-03: subreads-only, " "protocol §3/v1.3/v1.5 admits CCS/FLNC level only")) rows += list(rows_for_declared_runs()) rows += list(rows_for_resources()) demote_duplicates(rows) return rows

nodes.name: scope_filter
nodes.body_text: def scope_filter(rows, scope): """Select the rows of one freeze scope. Protocol section 1 freezes the manifest in scopes rather than all at once, because the two bodies of evidence complete at different times: EST finished downloading on 2026-09-01 and was frozen as DATASET_ROLES.est_v1.tsv, while long-read collection was still running and a single freeze would have gone stale within the hour. The long-read scope is everything that is neither EST nor a declared non-run resource. It keeps a dataset's auxiliary files (the Wang 2020 reference GFF and demultiplex counts) because they belong to that dataset, and it keeps `excluded` rows on purpose: a freeze that records only what was kept cannot be audited against what was rejected. """ if scope == "est": return [r for r in rows if r["run"] == "est.fa.gz"] if scope == "longread": return [r for r in rows if r["run"] != "est.fa.gz" and r["data_type"] not in RESOURCE_DATA_TYPES] return list(rows)

nodes.name: validate
nodes.body_text: def validate(rows): """The manifest is only worth having if it is complete and unambiguous. Refuse to write otherwise.""" v = [] seen = {} for r in rows: k = (r["dataset"], r["run"]) if k in seen: v.append(f"duplicate entry {k}") seen[k] = r if r["role"] not in ROLES: v.append(f"{k}: invalid role {r['role']!r}") if not r["species"]: v.append(f"{k}: no species") if r["source_checksum_authority"] == "none" and not r["local_fa_md5"]: v.append(f"{k}: no checksum of any kind") if r["source_checksum_authority"] == "ENA_fastq_md5" and not r["source_checksum"]: v.append(f"{k}: claims an ENA checksum but carries none") # A18.3: every run occurs exactly once. The (dataset, run) check above cannot see a run that was # downloaded twice into two different dataset paths, which is what happened to Cui 2020. by_run: dict = {} for r in rows: if r["data_type"] in ("reference_gff", "demultiplex_counts") + RESOURCE_DATA_TYPES or r["run"] == "est.fa.gz": continue by_run.setdefault(r["run"], []).append(r["dataset"]) for run, datasets in sorted(by_run.items()): if len(datasets) < 2: continue canonical = DUPLICATE_RESOLUTION.get(run) if canonical is None: v.append(f"run {run} appears in {len(datasets)} datasets {sorted(datasets)} and no canonical " f"copy is declared in DUPLICATE_RESOLUTION") elif canonical not in datasets: v.append(f"run {run}: declared canonical {canonical!r} is not one of {sorted(datasets)}") else: for r in rows: if r["run"] == run and r["dataset"] != canonical and r["role"] != "excluded": v.append(f"run {run}: non-canonical copy in {r['dataset']} is {r['role']}, must be excluded") # A declared run must stay exactly one row. If it is ever downloaded, the scan produces a # second row for the same (dataset, run) and the declaration has to be removed deliberately # rather than left to collide. for d in DECLARED_RUNS: k = (d["dataset"], d["run"]) matches = [r for r in rows if (r["dataset"], r["run"]) == k] if len(matches) != 1: v.append(f"declared run {k} occurs {len(matches)} times; expected exactly once " f"(was it collected after all? then drop the declaration)") for sp in TEST_SPECIES: bad = [r for r in rows if r["species"] == sp and r["role"] == "c2_training_eligible"] if bad: v.append(f"test species {sp} marked training-eligible: {[r['run'] for r in bad]}") if not any(r["dataset"] == "ont/Athaliana_cui2020_PRJNA594286" and r["role"] == "c2_training_eligible" for r in rows): v.append("A18.3: ont/Athaliana_cui2020_PRJNA594286 must be c2_training_eligible") for ds in ("ont/Athaliana_FLIC_PRJNA1087576", "pacbio/Athaliana_zhang2023_PRJNA911826"): bad = [r for r in rows if r["dataset"] == ds and r["role"] != "b1_validation_only"] if bad: v.append(f"A14: {ds} must be b1_validation_only") return v

nodes.name: main
nodes.body_text: def main(): ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__) ap.add_argument("--root", default=ROOT_DEFAULT) ap.add_argument("--out", default=None, help="default: <root>/DATASET_ROLES.tsv") ap.add_argument("--summary", default=None, help="write a JSON summary next to the manifest") ap.add_argument("--scope", choices=["all", "est", "longread"], default="all", help="est = only the EST rows. Author decision 2026-09-03: EST is complete and cannot " "change, so its roles are frozen first and the long-read scope gets its own v2 " "freeze once collection finishes (protocol line 213 asks the manifest to be " "checksummed into §1 before the first alignment)") ap.add_argument("--verify-resources", action="store_true", help="recompute the declared resources' md5 from the files themselves (over ssh) " "and refuse to write on a mismatch or on a file that cannot be read") a = ap.parse_args() out = a.out or os.path.join(a.root, "DATASET_ROLES.tsv") rows = build(a.root) violations = validate(rows) # 검증은 항상 전체에 대해 한다 if a.verify_resources: violations += verify_resources() else: print(f"note: {len(RESOURCES)} declared resource(s) were not checked against their files " f"this run; pass --verify-resources to recompute their md5", file=sys.stderr) rows = scope_filter(rows, a.scope) if violations: print("manifest refused:", file=sys.stderr) for x in violations: print(" " + x, file=sys.stderr) sys.exit(1) rows.sort(key=lambda r: (r["role"], r["species"], r["dataset"], r["run"])) with open(out, "w", newline="") as fh: w = csv.DictWriter(fh, fieldnames=FIELDS, delimiter="\t", lineterminator="\n") w.writeheader() w.writerows(rows) summary = {"rows": len(rows), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(open(out, "rb").read()).hexdigest(), "by_role": {}, "by_role_species": {}} for r in rows: summary["by_role"][r["role"]] = summary["by_role"].get(r["role"], 0) + 1 summary["by_role_species"].setdefault(r["role"], {}) summary["by_role_species"][r["role"]][r["species"]] = \ summary["by_role_species"][r["role"]].get(r["species"], 0) + 1 if a.summary: with open(a.summary, "w") as fh: json.dump(summary, fh, indent=1, sort_keys=True) print(json.dumps(summary, indent=1, sort_keys=True))

nodes.name: mvp_align_panel_longreads.py
nodes.body_text: #!/usr/bin/env python3 """Scoring-only, local two-pass long-read alignment; never training evidence. Canonical roles: ROOT/evidence/DATASET_ROLES.longread_v1.tsv (not repo copy). Outputs only ROOT/evidence/mvp_scoring_20260916/RUN, fresh directory required. External commands run only with --execute; this file submits no jobs. Requires an EXTERNAL frozen-reference identity gate: caller MD5 values check bytes only, not frozen reference/GFF identity. This partial preparatory driver cannot establish scientific input validation, coverage approval, or training authorization. Operational promotion also requires anchored producer receipts. """ import argparse import csv import hashlib import json import re import subprocess import sys from pathlib import Path SCRIPTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] sys.path.insert(0, str(SCRIPTS.parents[1] / 'src')) from transgenic.evidence import mvp_windows as w ROLE_COLUMNS = ('dataset run species genotype_stratum instrument data_type expected_files ' 'expected_reads source_checksum source_checksum_authority local_fa_md5 role basis note').split() ONT_RUNS = {'SRR28341943', 'SRR28341944', 'SRR28341945'} HIFI_RUNS = {'ERR13994458'} if __name__ == '__main__': main()

nodes.name: digest
nodes.body_text: def digest(path): h = hashlib.md5() with Path(path).open('rb') as f: for block in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b''): h.update(block) return h.hexdigest()

nodes.name: validate_read
nodes.body_text: def validate_read(root, run, reads): if run not in ONT_RUNS | HIFI_RUNS: raise ValueError('run is not A-ONT1 / A-HiFi') roles = Path(root).resolve() / 'evidence/DATASET_ROLES.longread_v1.tsv' with roles.open() as f: reader = csv.DictReader(f, delimiter='\t') if reader.fieldnames != ROLE_COLUMNS: raise ValueError('canonical roles schema mismatch') rows = list(reader) if any(None in r or any(v is None for v in r.values()) for r in rows): raise ValueError('malformed canonical roles row') selected = [r for r in rows if r['run'] == run] if len(selected) != 1: raise ValueError('expected exactly one canonical run role') row = selected[0] if (row['role'], row['species'], row['genotype_stratum']) != ('b1_validation_only', 'Athaliana', 'reference'): raise ValueError('scoring requires reference Athaliana b1_validation_only; no training bypass') if not re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{32}', row['local_fa_md5']) or digest(Path(reads).resolve()) != row['local_fa_md5']: raise ValueError('actual consumed read file md5 mismatch') return row

nodes.name: audit_key
nodes.body_text: def audit_key(reads, ref, gff): return ':'.join(digest(p) for p in (reads, ref, gff, SCRIPTS / '67_orientation_audit.py'))

nodes.name: read_audit
nodes.body_text: def read_audit(out, key, run): marker = dict(line.split('=', 1) for line in (out / 'DONE').read_text().splitlines()) if marker.get('key') != key or marker.get('audit_md5') != digest(out / 'audit.json'): raise ValueError('stale orientation DONE key or audit md5') result = json.loads((out / 'audit.json').read_text()) if result['run'] != run or result['species'] != 'Athaliana': raise ValueError('orientation identity mismatch') if (result['min_mapq'], result['min_eligible'], result['threshold']) != (20, 1000, .95): raise ValueError('orientation parameters drifted') valid, sense = result['valid_for_orientation'], result['read_sense'] if type(valid) is not int or type(sense) is not int or not 0 <= sense <= valid: raise ValueError('invalid orientation counts') status = 'UNRESOLVED' if valid < 1000 else ('PASS' if sense / valid >= .95 else 'FAIL') if result['status'] != status or result['use_uf'] is not (status == 'PASS'): raise ValueError('inconsistent orientation decision') return result

nodes.name: audit_from_sam
nodes.signature: def audit_from_sam(sam, gff, out, run, dataset, key)

nodes.name: pass2_command
nodes.signature: def pass2_command(source, uf, ref, reads, threads)
nodes.body_text: def pass2_command(source, uf, ref, reads, threads): if source not in ('ONT', 'HiFi') or (source == 'HiFi' and uf): raise ValueError('invalid source/orientation combination') command = ['minimap2', '-t', str(threads), '-ax', 'splice' if source == 'ONT' else 'splice:hq'] if source == 'ONT': command += (['-uf'] if uf else []) + ['-k14'] return command + ['-G', '200000', '--secondary=no', '--cs=long', str(ref), str(reads)]

nodes.name: select_names
nodes.body_text: def select_names(paf_lines, loci): windows = w.prefilter_by_chromosome(loci) names = set() for line in paf_lines: f = line.rstrip('\n').split('\t') if len(f) < 12: raise ValueError('malformed pass1 PAF') start, end, quality = int(f[7]), int(f[8]), int(f[11]) if not 0 <= start < end <= int(f[6]) or not 0 <= quality <= 255: raise ValueError('invalid pass1 coordinates/mapq') if quality >= 5 and any(start < b and end > a for a, b in windows.get(f[5], ())): names.add(f[0]) return sorted(names)

nodes.name: output_directory
nodes.body_text: def output_directory(root, run): if run not in ONT_RUNS | HIFI_RUNS: raise ValueError('unknown scoring run') out = Path(root).resolve() / 'evidence/mvp_scoring_20260916' / run if out.resolve() != out: raise ValueError('scoring namespace must not be redirected by symlinks') return out

nodes.name: execute
nodes.body_text: def execute(args): root, reads, ref, gff = (Path(p).resolve() for p in (args.root, args.reads, args.ref, args.gff)) row = validate_read(root, args.run, reads) for path, expected in [(ref, args.ref_md5), (gff, args.gff_md5)]: if not re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{32}', expected) or digest(path) != expected: raise ValueError('reference/GFF md5 mismatch') loci = w.load_panel(args.panels) # No dependence on an unverified .fai: stream actual FASTA lengths. lengths = {} chrom = None with ref.open() as f: for line in f: if line.startswith('>'): chrom = line[1:].split()[0] if chrom in lengths: raise ValueError('duplicate reference contig') lengths[chrom] = 0 elif line.strip(): if chrom is None: raise ValueError('invalid reference FASTA') lengths[chrom] += len(line.strip()) w.windows_by_chromosome(loci, lengths) if args.threads < 1: raise ValueError('threads must be positive') boundary = dict(reference_identity_status='UNVERIFIED', scientific_input_validation=False, external_frozen_reference_gate_required=True, training_eligible=False) if not args.execute: return dict(boundary, status='PREPARATORY_BYTE_CHECKS_ONLY', role=row, coverage_policy='PENDING') out = output_directory(root, args.run) out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False) roles = root / 'evidence/DATASET_ROLES.longread_v1.tsv' inputs = {str(p): digest(p) for p in (reads, ref, gff, roles, Path(args.panels).resolve())} commands = [] def run(command, output=None): commands.append([str(x) for x in command]) (out / 'commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(commands, indent=2)) with (out / 'commands.stderr').open('a') as err: if output is None: subprocess.run(command, check=True, stderr=err) else: with output.open('x') as f: subprocess.run(command, check=True, stdout=f, stderr=err) try: source = 'ONT' if args.run in ONT_RUNS else 'HiFi' uf = False if source == 'ONT': audit = out / 'orientation'; audit.mkdir() run([sys.executable, str(SCRIPTS / '68_sample_fasta.py'), '--fasta', str(reads), '--out', str(audit / 'sample.fa'), '--n', '10000', '--md5', digest(reads)], audit / 'sample.json') run(pass2_command('ONT', False, ref, audit / 'sample.fa', args.threads), audit / 'sample.sam') uf = audit_from_sam(audit / 'sample.sam', gff, audit, args.run, row['dataset'], audit_key(reads, ref, gff))['use_uf'] run(['minimap2', '-t', str(args.threads), '-x', 'splice', str(ref), str(reads)], out / 'pass1.paf') with (out / 'pass1.paf').open() as f: names = select_names(f, loci) (out / 'panel_reads.txt').write_text(''.join(n + '\n' for n in names)) if not names: raise ValueError('no candidate reads; independent scoring unavailable, not negative') run(['seqkit', 'grep', '-f', str(out / 'panel_reads.txt'), str(reads)], out / 'panel_reads.fa') run(pass2_command(source, uf, ref, out / 'panel_reads.fa', args.threads), out / 'panel.sam') run(['samtools', 'sort', '-o', str(out / 'panel.bam'), str(out / 'panel.sam')]) run(['samtools', 'index', str(out / 'panel.bam')]) run([sys.executable, str(SCRIPTS / 'mvp/mvp_junction_table.py'), '--alignment', f'{source}:uf={str(uf).lower()}:{out / "panel.bam"}', '--panels', str(Path(args.panels).resolve()), '--out', str(out / 'junctions.tsv'), '--qc-out', str(out / 'junctions.qc.json')]) if any(digest(p) != d for p, d in inputs.items()): raise ValueError('input mutated during scoring') report = dict(boundary, label='exploratory / MVP', role=row, inputs_md5=inputs, commands=commands, source=source, use_uf=uf, run=args.run, panel_sha256=w.PANEL_SHA256, coverage_policy='PENDING', outputs_md5={p.name: digest(p) for p in out.iterdir() if p.is_file()}, status='PREPARATORY_COMMANDS_COMPLETED') (out / 'alignment.json.tmp').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)) (out / 'alignment.json.tmp').rename(out / 'alignment.json') return report except Exception as error: (out / 'FAILED.json').write_text(json.dumps({'error': str(error), 'training_eligible': False})) raise

nodes.name: run
nodes.body_text: def run(command, output=None): commands.append([str(x) for x in command]) (out / 'commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(commands, indent=2)) with (out / 'commands.stderr').open('a') as err: if output is None: subprocess.run(command, check=True, stderr=err) else: with output.open('x') as f: subprocess.run(command, check=True, stdout=f, stderr=err)

nodes.name: main
nodes.body_text: def main(argv=None): p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__) for name in ('root', 'run', 'reads', 'ref', 'gff', 'panels'): p.add_argument('--' + name, required=True) for name in ('ref-md5', 'gff-md5'): p.add_argument('--' + name, required=True, help='caller-supplied byte checksum only; external frozen-reference identity gate still required') p.add_argument('--threads', type=int, default=32) p.add_argument('--execute', action='store_true') print(json.dumps(execute(p.parse_args(argv)), indent=2))

nodes.name: mvp_build_c0lite.py
nodes.body_text: #!/usr/bin/env python3 """Exploratory Athaliana MVP only; no scoring filters or trainer dependencies. Coordinates: spans/blocks half-open; junction endpoints inclusive. est_molecule's primary placement is a deterministic representative, NOT the component geometry. Use est_block/est_junction for tracks, est_placement for leakage/provenance. """ import argparse import csv import hashlib import json import os from pathlib import Path import re import sys import tempfile import duckdb import pysam SPEC_SHA256 = '734387b0a3251e7b0f47cf36bb0edc0dc51549a02f0c2d2579765d5445879c74' BATCH_SIZE = 4096 PANEL_COLUMNS = ('panel shuffle_rank species_id gene_id chromosome start fin strand length ' 'orthogroup_id n_transcripts exon_count intron_count est_molecules').split() if __name__ == '__main__': raise SystemExit(main())

nodes.name: sha256
nodes.body_text: def sha256(path): h = hashlib.sha256() with open(path, 'rb') as fh: for block in iter(lambda: fh.read(1024 * 1024), b''): h.update(block) return h.hexdigest()

nodes.name: require
nodes.body_text: def require(ok, message): if not ok: raise ValueError(message)

nodes.name: batches
nodes.body_text: def batches(con, sql): """Separate cursor allows bounded reads while the main connection writes.""" cur = con.cursor() try: cur.execute(sql) while True: rows = cur.fetchmany(BATCH_SIZE) if not rows: break yield rows finally: cur.close()

nodes.name: clone_key
nodes.body_text: def clone_key(name): return re.sub(r'(?:\.\d+|_[FR])+$', '', name)

nodes.name: load_sources
nodes.signature: def load_sources(con, corpus_db, panels, flank, references)
nodes.body_text: def load_sources(con, corpus_db, panels, flank, references): sidecar = Path(str(panels) + '.sha256') if sidecar.exists(): fields = sidecar.read_text().split() require(fields and fields[0] == sha256(panels), 'panel sha256 mismatch') con.execute('BEGIN') protected = [] seen = set() with open(panels) as fh: reader = csv.DictReader(fh, delimiter='\t') require(reader.fieldnames == PANEL_COLUMNS, 'invalid panel columns/order') for row in reader: require(row['species_id'] == 'Athaliana', 'panels must contain only Athaliana') require(row['panel'] in ('mvp_core', 'mvp', 'pilot', 'final'), 'invalid panel label') a, b = int(row['start']) - 1, int(row['fin']) chrom = row['chromosome'] require(chrom in references and 0 <= a < b <= references[chrom], 'invalid panel coordinates/reference') require(row['strand'] in ('+', '-') and int(row['length']) == b-a, 'invalid panel strand/length') require(row['gene_id'] and row['gene_id'] not in seen, 'duplicate/empty panel gene') seen.add(row['gene_id']) protected.append((chrom, max(0, a-flank), b+flank, 'panel')) require(protected, 'empty panel universe') con.execute('CREATE TABLE protected_span(chrom VARCHAR, start0 BIGINT, end0 BIGINT, kind VARCHAR)') con.executemany('INSERT INTO protected_span VALUES (?,?,?,?)', protected) panel_count = len(protected) con.execute('CREATE TABLE corpus_tile(rn BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, chrom VARCHAR, start0 BIGINT, end0 BIGINT, split VARCHAR, is_rc BOOLEAN)') with duckdb.connect(str(corpus_db), read_only=True) as src: for table, columns in [('geneList', {'rn','species_id','chromosome','start','fin','split','is_rc'}), ('tile_blocks', {'species_id','chromosome','start0','end0','split'})]: actual = {r[0] for r in src.execute('SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = ?', [table]).fetchall()} require(columns <= actual, f'{table}: missing required columns {sorted(columns-actual)}') n_tiles = 0 for rows in batches(src, "SELECT rn,chromosome,start,fin,split,is_rc FROM geneList WHERE species_id='Athaliana'"): for rn, chrom, a, b, split, rc in rows: # B5 pads a short contig's [0,tier) tile beyond the reference. require(chrom in references and a is not None and b is not None and 0 <= a < min(b,references[chrom]) and (b <= references[chrom] or (a == 0 and b in (30720,61440,129024))), 'invalid Athaliana tile coordinates/reference') require(rn is not None and split in ('train','valid','test') and rc is not None, 'invalid Athaliana tile metadata') con.executemany('INSERT INTO corpus_tile VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)', rows) n_tiles += len(rows) require(n_tiles > 0, 'corpus has no Athaliana tiles') for rows in batches(src, "SELECT chromosome,start0,end0,split FROM tile_blocks WHERE species_id='Athaliana'"): tests = [] for chrom, a, b, split in rows: require(chrom in references and a is not None and b is not None and 0 <= a < b <= references[chrom], 'invalid Athaliana block coordinates/reference') require(split in ('train','valid','test'), 'invalid tile_blocks split') if split == 'test': tests.append((chrom,a,b,'test')) if tests: con.executemany('INSERT INTO protected_span VALUES (?,?,?,?)', tests) con.execute('COMMIT') return panel_count

nodes.name: stage_bam
nodes.body_text: def stage_bam(con, fh): con.execute('CREATE TABLE est_placement(placement_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, member VARCHAR, flag INTEGER, kind VARCHAR, chrom VARCHAR, alignment_strand VARCHAR, start0 BIGINT, end0 BIGINT, cigar VARCHAR, ts VARCHAR, tx_strand VARCHAR, mapq INTEGER)') con.execute('CREATE TABLE member_block(placement_id BIGINT, chrom VARCHAR, start0 BIGINT, end0 BIGINT)') con.execute('CREATE TABLE member_junction(placement_id BIGINT, chrom VARCHAR, intron_start0 BIGINT, intron_end0 BIGINT)') tables = {'est_placement': ([],12), 'member_block': ([],4), 'member_junction': ([],4)} qc = {'reads_in': 0, 'secondary_ignored': 0, 'max_stage_batch_rows': 0} def flush(table): rows, width = tables[table] if rows: qc['max_stage_batch_rows'] = max(qc['max_stage_batch_rows'], len(rows)) con.executemany(f'INSERT INTO {table} VALUES ({",".join("?" for _ in range(width))})', rows) rows.clear() def add(table, row): tables[table][0].append(row) if len(tables[table][0]) >= BATCH_SIZE: flush(table) con.execute('BEGIN') for i, r in enumerate(fh.fetch(until_eof=True)): qc['reads_in'] += 1 require(r.query_name and r.query_name != '*', 'BAM member name required') strand = '-' if r.flag & 16 else '+' ts = r.get_tag('ts') if r.has_tag('ts') else None # A39 composition only. Deliberately do not reuse scorer exclusion/MAPQ policy. tx = strand if ts == '+' else ('+' if strand == '-' else '-') if ts == '-' else '?' kind = 'secondary' if r.is_secondary else 'unmapped' if r.is_unmapped else 'supplementary' if r.is_supplementary else 'primary' chrom = a = end = cigar = None if kind == 'secondary': qc['secondary_ignored'] += 1 elif kind != 'unmapped': chrom, a, cigar = r.reference_name, r.reference_start, r.cigarstring require(r.cigartuples and chrom and a >= 0, 'mapped placement needs reference/CIGAR') pos = block_start = a for op, n in r.cigartuples: require(n > 0 and op in (0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8), 'invalid CIGAR operation') if op == 3: require(pos > block_start, 'empty CIGAR block before N') if kind == 'primary': add('member_block', (i,chrom,block_start,pos)) add('member_junction', (i,chrom,pos,pos+n-1)) pos += n block_start = pos elif op in (0,2,7,8): pos += n require(pos > block_start and pos <= fh.get_reference_length(chrom), 'invalid placement span') end = pos if kind == 'primary': add('member_block', (i,chrom,block_start,pos)) add('est_placement', (i,r.query_name,r.flag,kind,chrom,strand,a,end,cigar,ts,tx,r.mapping_quality)) for table in tables: flush(table) con.execute('COMMIT') return qc

nodes.name: flush
nodes.body_text: def flush(table): rows, width = tables[table] if rows: qc['max_stage_batch_rows'] = max(qc['max_stage_batch_rows'], len(rows)) con.executemany(f'INSERT INTO {table} VALUES ({",".join("?" for _ in range(width))})', rows) rows.clear()

nodes.name: add
nodes.body_text: def add(table, row): tables[table][0].append(row) if len(tables[table][0]) >= BATCH_SIZE: flush(table)

nodes.name: resolve_components
nodes.signature: def resolve_components(con, qc): # ponytail: O(unique QNAMEs) union-find RAM; placements/geometry stay on disk. # Replace with external-memory connectivity only if the real name count needs it.
nodes.body_text: def resolve_components(con, qc): # ponytail: O(unique QNAMEs) union-find RAM; placements/geometry stay on disk. # Replace with external-memory connectivity only if the real name count needs it. parent = {} for rows in batches(con, 'SELECT DISTINCT member FROM est_placement'): parent.update((name,name) for name, in rows) def root(name): while parent[name] != name: parent[name] = parent[parent[name]] name = parent[name] return name def union(a, b): a, b = root(a), root(b) if a == b: return 0 parent[max(a,b)] = min(a,b) return 1 qc['members_in'] = len(parent) qc['collapsed_rule_a'] = 0 last_key = last_name = None sql = "SELECT chrom,alignment_strand,start0,cigar,member FROM est_placement WHERE kind='primary' ORDER BY chrom,alignment_strand,start0,cigar,member" for rows in batches(con, sql): for *key, name in rows: if key == last_key: qc['collapsed_rule_a'] += union(last_name, name) last_key, last_name = key, name con.execute('CREATE TABLE est_member(member VARCHAR PRIMARY KEY, clone_key VARCHAR, component VARCHAR, molecule_id VARCHAR)') con.execute('BEGIN') pending = [] for name in parent: pending.append((name,clone_key(name),None,None)) if len(pending) == BATCH_SIZE: con.executemany('INSERT INTO est_member VALUES (?,?,?,?)', pending) pending.clear() if pending: con.executemany('INSERT INTO est_member VALUES (?,?,?,?)', pending) con.execute('COMMIT') qc['collapsed_rule_b'] = 0 last_key = last_name = None for rows in batches(con, 'SELECT clone_key,member FROM est_member ORDER BY clone_key,member'): for key, name in rows: if key and key == last_key: qc['collapsed_rule_b'] += union(last_name,name) last_key, last_name = key, name con.execute('BEGIN') pending = [] for name in parent: pending.append((root(name),name)) if len(pending) == BATCH_SIZE: con.executemany('UPDATE est_member SET component=? WHERE member=?', pending) pending.clear() if pending: con.executemany('UPDATE est_member SET component=? WHERE member=?', pending) con.execute('COMMIT') con.execute('CREATE TEMP TABLE components AS SELECT component, list(member ORDER BY member) members, sha256(to_json(list(member ORDER BY member))) molecule_id FROM est_member GROUP BY component') con.execute('UPDATE est_member SET molecule_id=c.molecule_id FROM components c WHERE est_member.component=c.component') con.execute('ALTER TABLE est_member DROP COLUMN component') con.execute('''CREATE TEMP TABLE placement_hits AS SELECT p.placement_id, bool_or(s.kind='panel') overlaps_panel, bool_or(s.kind='test') overlaps_test FROM est_placement p JOIN protected_span s ON p.chrom=s.chrom AND p.start0<s.end0 AND p.end0>s.start0 WHERE p.kind IN ('primary','supplementary') GROUP BY p.placement_id''') con.execute('''CREATE TEMP TABLE summary AS SELECT e.molecule_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.kind='primary') primary_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.kind='supplementary') supplementary_count, count(DISTINCT p.tx_strand) FILTER (WHERE p.kind='primary' AND p.tx_strand IN ('+','-')) known_strands, min(p.tx_strand) FILTER (WHERE p.kind='primary' AND p.tx_strand IN ('+','-')) known_strand, max(p.mapq) FILTER (WHERE p.kind='primary') mapq, coalesce(bool_or(h.overlaps_panel),false) overlaps_panel, coalesce(bool_or(h.overlaps_test),false) overlaps_test FROM est_member e JOIN est_placement p ON e.member=p.member LEFT JOIN placement_hits h USING(placement_id) GROUP BY e.molecule_id''') con.execute('''CREATE TABLE est_molecule AS WITH representative AS ( SELECT e.molecule_id,p.chrom,p.start0,p.end0, row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY e.molecule_id ORDER BY p.chrom,p.start0,p.end0,p.alignment_strand,p.cigar,p.member) n FROM est_member e JOIN est_placement p ON e.member=p.member WHERE p.kind='primary') SELECT c.molecule_id,c.members,CASE WHEN s.known_strands=1 THEN s.known_strand ELSE '?' END strand, s.mapq,r.chrom,r.start0,r.end0, (s.primary_count=0 OR s.overlaps_panel OR s.overlaps_test) excluded, CASE WHEN s.primary_count=0 THEN CASE WHEN s.supplementary_count>0 THEN 'supplementary_only' ELSE 'unmapped' END WHEN s.overlaps_panel THEN 'heldout_locus' WHEN s.overlaps_test THEN 'test_block' ELSE NULL END cause, s.overlaps_panel,s.overlaps_test,s.primary_count,s.known_strands>1 strand_conflict FROM components c JOIN summary s USING(molecule_id) LEFT JOIN representative r ON c.molecule_id=r.molecule_id AND r.n=1''') con.execute('ALTER TABLE est_molecule ADD PRIMARY KEY(molecule_id)') # Running MAX (not lag) handles nested and repeated blocks before interval union. con.execute('''CREATE TABLE est_block AS WITH raw AS ( SELECT DISTINCT e.molecule_id,b.chrom,b.start0,b.end0 FROM member_block b JOIN est_placement p USING(placement_id) JOIN est_member e ON p.member=e.member), prior AS (SELECT *,max(end0) OVER(PARTITION BY molecule_id,chrom ORDER BY start0,end0 ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) prev_end FROM raw), islands AS (SELECT *,sum(CASE WHEN prev_end IS NULL OR start0>prev_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER(PARTITION BY molecule_id,chrom ORDER BY start0,end0) grp FROM prior) SELECT molecule_id,c

nodes.name: root
nodes.body_text: def root(name): while parent[name] != name: parent[name] = parent[parent[name]] name = parent[name] return name

nodes.name: union
nodes.body_text: def union(a, b): a, b = root(a), root(b) if a == b: return 0 parent[max(a,b)] = min(a,b) return 1

nodes.name: final_qc
nodes.body_text: def final_qc(con, qc): qc['molecules_after_dedup'] = con.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM est_molecule').fetchone()[0] qc['collapsed_total'] = qc['members_in'] - qc['molecules_after_dedup'] for cause in ('heldout_locus','test_block','unmapped','supplementary_only'): qc['excluded_' + cause] = con.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM est_molecule WHERE cause=?',[cause]).fetchone()[0] qc['retained'] = con.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM est_molecule WHERE NOT excluded').fetchone()[0] qc['strand_conflicts'] = con.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM est_molecule WHERE strand_conflict').fetchone()[0] qc['valid_tiles_total'] = con.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM corpus_tile WHERE split='valid'").fetchone()[0] qc['valid_tiles_with_evidence'] = con.execute("SELECT count(DISTINCT t.rn) FROM corpus_tile t JOIN tile_est e USING(rn) WHERE t.split='valid'").fetchone()[0] # Independent rejoin: do NOT trust placement_hits or stored component overlap flags. for kind in ('panel','test'): value = con.execute('''SELECT count(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) FROM est_molecule m JOIN est_member e USING(molecule_id) JOIN est_placement p ON e.member=p.member JOIN protected_span s ON s.chrom=p.chrom AND p.start0<s.end0 AND p.end0>s.start0 WHERE NOT m.excluded AND p.kind IN ('primary','supplementary') AND s.kind=?''',[kind]).fetchone()[0] qc['retained_overlapping_' + kind] = value require(value == 0, f'QC failed: retained overlap with {kind}') require(qc['collapsed_total'] == qc['collapsed_rule_a'] + qc['collapsed_rule_b'], 'dedup accounting mismatch') con.execute('CREATE TABLE mvp_qc(metric VARCHAR PRIMARY KEY, value BIGINT)') con.executemany('INSERT INTO mvp_qc VALUES (?,?)', list(qc.items()))

nodes.name: build_c0lite
nodes.signature: def build_c0lite(*, bam, panels, corpus_db, out, flank=150)
nodes.body_text: def build_c0lite(*, bam, panels, corpus_db, out, flank=150): """Build atomically, never overwrite; return numeric QC. Input corpus is read-only.""" bam, panels, corpus_db, out = map(lambda p: Path(p).absolute(), (bam,panels,corpus_db,out)) require(isinstance(flank,int) and flank >= 0, 'flank must be a nonnegative integer') for source in (bam,panels,corpus_db): require(source.is_file(), f'input missing: {source}') require(out.resolve() != source.resolve(), 'output/input collision') if os.path.lexists(out): raise FileExistsError(out) require(not Path(str(corpus_db)+'.wal').exists(), 'corpus has a WAL; supply a closed/checkpointed snapshot') out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True) handle, tmp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=out.name+'.partial-', dir=out.parent) os.close(handle) os.unlink(tmp_name) # DuckDB must create its own file header. con = None try: con = duckdb.connect(tmp_name, config={'threads':1}) with pysam.AlignmentFile(str(bam), 'rb') as fh: references = dict(zip(fh.references,fh.lengths)) panel_count = load_sources(con,corpus_db,panels,flank,references) qc = stage_bam(con,fh) resolve_components(con,qc) qc['panel_rows_protected'] = panel_count final_qc(con,qc) provenance = {'schema_version':'mvp_c0lite_v1', 'spec_sha256':SPEC_SHA256, 'bam':str(bam), 'panels':str(panels), 'corpus_db':str(corpus_db), 'bam_sha256':sha256(bam), 'panels_sha256':sha256(panels), 'corpus_sha256':sha256(corpus_db), 'flank':flank, 'panel_universe':'all supplied rows (production approved panel: 2079)', 'strand_policy':'primary known strands: single known wins; conflicting known -> ?; all unknown -> ?', 'geometry_policy':'union primary blocks; distinct primary junctions; representative primary is lexicographic chrom/start/end/FLAG-strand/CIGAR/member; mapq=max primary', 'exclusion_policy':'full primary/supplementary spans including introns; no-primary disposition first; then panel before test; preserve both flags', 'secondary_policy':'names retained; secondary geometry ignored; secondary-only cause=unmapped (no usable primary)', 'molecule_id':'sha256 UTF-8 compact JSON array of sorted unique member names (DuckDB to_json)', 'dedup_counts':'successful union edges: rule a first, then rule b; order within each rule does not change counts', 'clone_policy':r'strip terminal runs of .digits and _F/_R; no library/UniVec inference', 'stage_batch_rows':BATCH_SIZE, 'duckdb_version':duckdb.__version__, 'pysam_version':pysam.__version__} con.execute('CREATE TABLE mvp_provenance(key VARCHAR PRIMARY KEY,value VARCHAR)') con.executemany('INSERT INTO mvp_provenance VALUES (?,?)', [(k,json.dumps(v,sort_keys=True)) for k,v in provenance.items()]) con.execute('CHECKPOINT') con.close() con = None os.link(tmp_name,out) # Atomic no-clobber publish, same filesystem. return qc finally: if con is not None: con.close() for path in (Path(tmp_name),Path(tmp_name+'.wal')): path.unlink(missing_ok=True)

nodes.name: main
nodes.body_text: def main(argv=None): parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__) parser.add_argument('--bam',required=True) parser.add_argument('--panels',required=True) parser.add_argument('--db',dest='corpus_db',required=True) parser.add_argument('--out',required=True) parser.add_argument('--flank',type=int,default=150) args = parser.parse_args(argv) try: print(json.dumps(build_c0lite(**vars(args)),sort_keys=True)) return 0 except (ValueError,OSError,duckdb.Error) as exc: print(f'C0-lite build failed: {exc}',file=sys.stderr) return 1

nodes.name: mvp_decode_panel.py
nodes.body_text: #!/usr/bin/env python3 """Decode exact 350-row transport from COMPLETE panel inputs and pinned runtime. --input adds panel_inputs (publication directory), encoder_tokenizer and runtime_preflight to the producer contract. See MVP_DECODER_INTEGRATION_REPORT.md. """ from __future__ import annotations import argparse import json import os from pathlib import Path import sys import tempfile ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'src')) sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent)) # No accidental network fetch from model's external Hyena config/tokenizer loader. os.environ['HF_HUB_OFFLINE'] = '1' os.environ['TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE'] = '1' from transgenic.evidence import mvp_decode as d, mvp_windows as w if __name__ == '__main__': raise SystemExit(main())

nodes.name: write_json
nodes.body_text: def write_json(path, value, *, before_publish=None): """Close durable sibling temp before atomic no-replace publication. Hard-link publication is the POSIX no-overwrite equivalent of rename. Failed temporary files are intentionally retained for diagnostics, never consumed. """ path = Path(path) with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode='w', dir=path.parent, prefix='.' + path.name + '.', suffix='.tmp', delete=False) as handle: temporary = Path(handle.name) json.dump(value, handle, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False) handle.write('\n') handle.flush() os.fsync(handle.fileno()) if before_publish is not None: before_publish() os.link(temporary, path) # atomic, fails if destination already exists temporary.unlink()

nodes.name: verify_runs
nodes.body_text: def verify_runs(payload, producer): from transgenic.training.mvp_cli import validate_candidate_records from transgenic.training.mvp_cli_runtime import verify_candidate_artifacts c = payload['candidate'] candidate = validate_candidate_records(c['acceptance'], c['acceptance_sha256'], c['inventory'], c['receipts']) artifacts = verify_candidate_artifacts(candidate, c['corpus'], c['evidence'], payload['panels']) d.require(set(payload['runs']) == {'1','2','3'}, 'exact seeds required') runs = {int(s): producer.verify_final(r['final'], int(s), artifacts['valid_rns'], artifacts['sha256'], r['code_manifest']) for s,r in payload['runs'].items()} d.require(len({r['code_manifest']['sha256'] for r in runs.values()}) == 1, 'cross-seed code mismatch') sources = {tuple(sorted((name, value['sha256']) for name,value in r['initialization'].items())) for r in runs.values()} d.require(len(sources) == 1, 'cross-seed initialization mismatch') return runs

nodes.name: sequences_from_fasta
nodes.body_text: def sequences_from_fasta(path, panel): from Bio import SeqIO result = {} for record in SeqIO.parse(str(path), 'fasta'): for locus in panel: if record.id == locus.chromosome: d.require(locus.gene_id not in result, 'duplicate FASTA chromosome') start,end = w.evaluation_window(locus, len(record)) result[locus.gene_id] = str(record.seq[start:end]) d.require(set(result) == {l.gene_id for l in panel}, 'missing FASTA chromosome') return result

nodes.name: completed_measurement
nodes.body_text: def completed_measurement(spec): record = d.checked_file(spec['receipt']) path = Path(record['path']) d.require(path.name == 'generation_cache_parity.json', 'completed bounded receipt required') d.require(not path.with_suffix('.FAILED.json').exists() and not path.with_suffix('.FAILED.json').is_symlink(), 'failed bounded receipt') done = path.with_suffix('.DONE') d.require(done.is_file() and done.read_bytes() == (record['sha256'] + '\n').encode(), 'completed bounded DONE digest required') wrapper = d.read_json(path) d.require(type(wrapper.get('schema_version')) is int and wrapper['schema_version'] == 1 and wrapper.get('preflight') == 'p3_generation_parity' and type(wrapper.get('exit_code')) is int and wrapper['exit_code'] == 0 and wrapper.get('timed_out') is False and 'signal' in wrapper and wrapper['signal'] is None and wrapper.get('pass') is True, 'successful bounded wrapper required') measurement = wrapper.get('measurement') binding = wrapper.get('bindings_sha256') d.require(isinstance(binding, str) and len(binding) == 64 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in binding) and isinstance(measurement, dict) and measurement.get('bindings_sha256') == binding, 'wrapper measurement binding mismatch') return measurement, [record, d.identity(done)]

nodes.name: project_closure
nodes.body_text: def project_closure(identity, spec): probe = Path(identity['probe_path']) d.require(probe.is_absolute() and probe.parts[-4:] == ('revision', 'scripts', 'mvp', 'real_probes.py'), 'unsupported probe checkout') old_root = probe.parents[3] for name, digest in PROBE_CODE.items(): # A snapshots imports BEFORE its final run_bounded import; do not invent # that historical import. Its sibling bytes are checked independently. if name != 'run_bounded.py' or str(probe.with_name(name)) in identity['imports']: d.require(identity['imports'].get(str(probe.with_name(name))) == digest, 'unreviewed probe/handshake implementation') # Explicit relative-root relocation only. Original imports still rehashed. audited = {relative: d.identity(ROOT / relative)['sha256'] for relative in DECODER_ONLY} digest = hashlib.sha256((json.dumps(audited, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) + '\n').encode()).hexdigest() d.require(spec.get('decoder_code_sha256') == digest, 'operator decoder code pin mismatch') return old_root, audited

nodes.body_text: def verify_loaded_modules(identity, remote_hashes, *, project_root=None, decoder_code=None, module_cache=None): """Actual Python/extension closure, not only the receipt's declared imports.""" records = [] for name, module in list(sys.modules.items()): file = getattr(module, '__file__', None) if not file: continue d.require(Path(file).is_file(), 'loaded module file missing: ' + name) actual = d.identity(file) path = Path(actual['path']) if name == 'transformers_modules' or name.startswith('transformers_modules.'): # No module-cache relocation: exact genuine probe path+bytes required. d.require(module_cache is not None and path.is_relative_to(module_cache) and identity['imports'].get(actual['path']) == actual['sha256'], 'remote cache relocation/unbound import unsupported') scaffold = (path.name == '__init__.py' and path.read_bytes() == b'' and path.relative_to(module_cache).parts == (*name.split('.'), '__init__.py')) d.require(scaffold or actual['sha256'] in remote_hashes, 'loaded remote-code asset mismatch') elif path.is_relative_to(ROOT): relative = str(path.relative_to(ROOT)) expected = identity['imports'].get(str(project_root / relative)) if project_root else None # Probe-consumed code always wins, even within decoder boundary. if expected is None and decoder_code is not None: expected = decoder_code.get(relative) d.require(expected == actual['sha256'], 'project implementation differs from probe/audit: ' + relative) else: d.require(identity['imports'].get(actual['path']) == actual['sha256'], 'loaded module outside preflight closure: ' + name) records.append(actual) return records

nodes.name: mvp_junction_table.py
nodes.body_text: #!/usr/bin/env python3 """Read-supported junction table for the B6 MVP scoring readout (exploratory). Wraps the frozen B1 evidence scorer `revision/scripts/59_evidence_support.py` — its SAM parsing, whole-read-group acceptance (`alignment_rejection`: primary only, MAPQ >= 20, supplementary/chimeric and cross-contig/strand discarded) and `transcript_strand` (A39 FLAG x ts:A composition) are REUSED, not reimplemented. Support thresholds are the scorer's frozen `THRESHOLDS`: ONT 3 / PacBio 2 (A-HiFi counts under the PacBio threshold). Counts are READS (UMI status unknown; never molecules). Restriction scope (Track B must-fix 2, scope 1): a junction is tabulated only when its intron span lies INSIDE a panel evaluation WINDOW (30,720 nt centred on the gene, shared derivation `mvp_windows.evaluation_window`). The panel-GENE restriction applies to predicted junctions and the recall denominator in mvp_score.py, not here. Output TSV columns: chrom intron_start0 intron_end0 tx_strand n_ONT n_HiFi supported Intron endpoints are 0-based inclusive; `supported` is true iff n_HiFi >= 2 or n_ONT >= 3. The complete-chain columns (chain_support_single_read / chain_callable) are added when 59_evidence_support.py itself runs on the same BAMs (spec §2), not fabricated here. A QC JSON sidecar records read accept/reject counts per input. """ import argparse import hashlib import importlib.util import json import sys from collections import Counter, defaultdict from pathlib import Path _SCRIPTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] _REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] sys.path.insert(0, str(_REPO / "src")) from transgenic.evidence import mvp_windows # noqa: E402 ES = load_evidence_support() # Frozen thresholds; a drifted scorer must stop this wrapper. assert ES.THRESHOLDS["ONT"] == 3 and ES.THRESHOLDS["PacBio"] == 2, \ "frozen 59_evidence_support THRESHOLDS drifted (expected ONT 3 / PacBio 2)" SOURCE_THRESHOLDS = {"ONT": ES.THRESHOLDS["ONT"], "HiFi": ES.THRESHOLDS["PacBio"]} HEADER = ("chrom", "intron_start0", "intron_end0", "tx_strand", "n_ONT", "n_HiFi", "supported") if __name__ == "__main__": sys.exit(main())
