_validate_evaluation_inputs(accelerator, model, eval_loader, expected, metadata, training_summary) _collective_preflight(accelerator, validate_preflight) lengths = _all_ints(accelerator, len(eval_loader)) if len(set(lengths)) != 1: raise ValueError(f"per-rank eval_loader lengths must be equal: {lengths}") identity = hashlib.sha256(_canonical_json({"expected_rns": expected, "metadata": metadata, "training_summary": training_summary})).hexdigest() if not _all_fixed_payloads_equal(accelerator, identity.encode("ascii")): raise ValueError("expected inventory, metadata, and training summary differ across ranks") local_records = [] local_error = None for batch in eval_loader: try: local_records.append(paired_metric_record(model, _to_device(batch, accelerator.device))) except Exception as error: local_error = local_error or error payload = b"" try: payload = _validate_bounds(local_records) except Exception as error: local_error = local_error or error transport_lengths = _transport_lengths(accelerator, local_error, payload) gathered_payloads = _gather_record_payload_bytes(accelerator, payload, transport_lengths) aggregate_status = None summary_payload = b"" if accelerator.is_main_process: try: records = [] for encoded in gathered_payloads: decoded = json.loads(encoded) if not isinstance(decoded, list): raise ValueError("gathered paired record payload must decode to a list") records.extend(decoded) _validate_bounds(records) summary_payload = _canonical_json(aggregate_paired_records(records, expected)) if len(summary_payload) > MVP_MAX_SERIALIZED_BYTES: raise ValueError("paired summary exceeds serialized byte cap") aggregate_status = _status() except Exception as error: aggregate_status = _status(error) aggregate_status = _broadcast_status(accelerator, aggregate_status) _raise_status(aggregate_status) summary = json.loads(_broadcast_payload_bytes(accelerator, summary_payload)) if prepublication_prepare is not None: _collective_preflight(accelerator, prepublication_prepare) if prepublication_check is not None: _collective_preflight(accelerator, prepublication_check) publication_status = None if accelerator.is_main_process: try: _publish_final(accelerator, model, summary, final_dir, metadata=metadata, training_summary=training_summary) publication_status = _status() except Exception as error: publication_status = _status(error) publication_status = _broadcast_status(accelerator, publication_status) accelerator.wait_for_everyone() _raise_status(publication_status) return summary

nodes.name: validate_preflight
nodes.body_text: def validate_preflight(): nonlocal expected expected = _validated_inventory(expected_rns) _validate_evaluation_inputs(accelerator, model, eval_loader, expected, metadata, training_summary)

nodes.name: mvp_metrics.py
nodes.body_text: """CPU-only paired loss metrics for the B6 MVP evaluation.""" import math from numbers import Integral, Real import torch _NUMERIC_FIELDS = ( "loss_off", "loss_on", "composite_loss_off", "composite_loss_on", "ce_numerator_off", "ce_denominator_off", "ce_numerator_on", "ce_denominator_on", ) _RTOL = 1e-6 _ATOL = 1e-8

nodes.name: weighted_ce
nodes.body_text: def weighted_ce(logits, labels): """Return float32 per-tile weighted CE, numerator, and target-weight denominator.""" if not isinstance(logits, torch.Tensor) or logits.ndim != 3 or not logits.is_floating_point(): raise ValueError("logits must be a floating [batch, length, vocabulary] tensor") if (not isinstance(labels, torch.Tensor) or labels.ndim != 2 or labels.shape != logits.shape[:2] or labels.shape[0] == 0): raise ValueError("labels must match nonempty logits batch and length dimensions") if labels.dtype != torch.long: raise ValueError("labels must contain int64 token IDs") if logits.shape[-1] <= 272: raise ValueError("vocabulary must include prescribed token ID 272") values = logits.float() if not torch.isfinite(values).all(): raise ValueError("logits must be finite") valid = labels.ne(-100) if not valid.any(dim=1).all(): raise ValueError("each tile must contain at least one non-ignored target") targets = labels.masked_select(valid) if (targets < 0).any() or (targets >= logits.shape[-1]).any(): raise ValueError("target token ID is outside the vocabulary") safe_labels = labels.masked_fill(~valid, 0) token_loss = -values.log_softmax(dim=-1).gather(-1, safe_labels.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1) weights = torch.ones_like(token_loss) weights = torch.where(labels.eq(2), 5.0, weights) weights = torch.where(labels.eq(17), 4.0, weights) weights = torch.where(labels.eq(21) | labels.eq(272), 3.0, weights) weights = torch.where((labels >= 22) & (labels <= 271), 2.0, weights) weights = weights * valid numerator = (token_loss * weights).sum(dim=1) denominator = weights.sum(dim=1) loss = numerator / denominator if (denominator <= 0).any() or not torch.isfinite(loss).all(): raise ValueError("weighted CE produced an invalid result") return loss, numerator, denominator

nodes.name: _scalar
nodes.body_text: def _scalar(value, name): if not isinstance(value, torch.Tensor) or value.numel() != 1: raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a scalar tensor") result = float(value.detach().item()) if not math.isfinite(result): raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite") return result

nodes.name: paired_metric_record
nodes.body_text: def paired_metric_record(model, batch): """Evaluate one collated 10-tuple tile with zero/off and caller-supplied/on tracks.""" if not isinstance(batch, (tuple, list)) or len(batch) != 10: raise ValueError("paired evaluation requires a collated 10-tuple batch") input_ids, attention_mask, labels, _, _, _, _, _, tracks, metadata = batch tensors = (input_ids, attention_mask, labels, tracks) if any(not isinstance(value, torch.Tensor) or value.ndim < 1 or value.shape[0] != 1 for value in tensors): raise ValueError("paired evaluation requires batch size one tensors") if not isinstance(metadata, dict) or not {"rn", "has_evidence"}.issubset(metadata): raise ValueError("batch metadata requires rn and has_evidence") rn_tensor, evidence_tensor = metadata["rn"], metadata["has_evidence"] integer_dtypes = (torch.int8, torch.int16, torch.int32, torch.int64, torch.uint8) if (not isinstance(rn_tensor, torch.Tensor) or rn_tensor.numel() != 1 or rn_tensor.dtype not in integer_dtypes or not isinstance(evidence_tensor, torch.Tensor) or evidence_tensor.numel() != 1 or evidence_tensor.dtype != torch.bool): raise ValueError("batch metadata must contain one integer rn and boolean evidence flag") rn = int(rn_tensor.item()) has_evidence = bool(evidence_tensor.item()) was_training = model.training model.eval() try: with torch.no_grad(): common = {"attention_mask": attention_mask, "labels": labels} off = model(input_ids, evidence_tracks=torch.zeros_like(tracks), **common) on = model(input_ids, evidence_tracks=tracks, **common) off_loss, off_num, off_den = weighted_ce(off.logits, labels) on_loss, on_num, on_den = weighted_ce(on.logits, labels) return { "rn": rn, "has_evidence": has_evidence, "loss_off": _scalar(off_loss, "loss_off"), "loss_on": _scalar(on_loss, "loss_on"), "composite_loss_off": _scalar(off.loss, "composite_loss_off"), "composite_loss_on": _scalar(on.loss, "composite_loss_on"), "ce_numerator_off": _scalar(off_num, "ce_numerator_off"), "ce_denominator_off": _scalar(off_den, "ce_denominator_off"), "ce_numerator_on": _scalar(on_num, "ce_numerator_on"), "ce_denominator_on": _scalar(on_den, "ce_denominator_on"), } finally: model.train(was_training)

nodes.name: _validated_record
nodes.body_text: def _validated_record(record): required = {"rn", "has_evidence", *_NUMERIC_FIELDS} if not isinstance(record, dict) or not required.issubset(record): raise ValueError("paired record is missing required fields") if isinstance(record["rn"], bool) or not isinstance(record["rn"], Integral): raise ValueError("record rn must be an integer") if not isinstance(record["has_evidence"], bool): raise ValueError("record has_evidence must be boolean") for field in _NUMERIC_FIELDS: value = record[field] if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, Real) or not math.isfinite(float(value)): raise ValueError(f"record {field} must be finite numeric") for suffix in ("off", "on"): denominator = float(record[f"ce_denominator_{suffix}"]) if denominator <= 0: raise ValueError("CE denominators must be positive") if not math.isclose(float(record[f"loss_{suffix}"]), float(record[f"ce_numerator_{suffix}"]) / denominator, rel_tol=_RTOL, abs_tol=_ATOL): raise ValueError("CE loss disagrees with its numerator and denominator") if not math.isclose(float(record["ce_denominator_off"]), float(record["ce_denominator_on"]), rel_tol=_RTOL, abs_tol=_ATOL): raise ValueError("off/on CE denominators disagree") return record

nodes.name: aggregate_paired_records
nodes.body_text: def aggregate_paired_records(records, expected_rns): """Deduplicate gathered records and compute equal-tile means. Duplicate floating fields must agree within rtol=1e-6 and atol=1e-8. The returned records retain one audited row per expected rn for later bootstrap. """ expected = list(expected_rns) if (any(isinstance(rn, bool) or not isinstance(rn, Integral) for rn in expected) or len(expected) != len(set(expected))): raise ValueError("expected rn inventory must contain unique integers") unique = {} for candidate in records: current = _validated_record(candidate) rn = current["rn"] if rn not in unique: unique[rn] = current continue previous = unique[rn] if previous["has_evidence"] != current["has_evidence"] or any( not math.isclose(float(previous[field]), float(current[field]), rel_tol=_RTOL, abs_tol=_ATOL) for field in _NUMERIC_FIELDS ): raise ValueError(f"duplicate records disagree for rn={rn}") missing = set(expected) - set(unique) extra = set(unique) - set(expected) if missing or extra: raise ValueError(f"rn inventory mismatch: missing={sorted(missing)}, extra={sorted(extra)}") ordered = [unique[rn] for rn in expected] evidence = [item for item in ordered if item["has_evidence"]] if not evidence: raise ValueError("evidence-positive paired subset is empty") primary = math.fsum(item["loss_off"] - item["loss_on"] for item in evidence) / len(evidence) composite = math.fsum(item["composite_loss_off"] - item["composite_loss_on"] for item in evidence) / len(evidence) return { "primary_delta": primary, "composite_delta": composite, "pair_count": len(evidence), "records": ordered, }

nodes.name: mvp_runtime.py
nodes.body_text: """Minimal fixed-update MVP training runtime. Ownership contract: the caller constructs an Accelerator with ``make_accelerator`` (or identical settings), prepares only the model and optimizer, and supplies an unprepared DataLoader. Under DDP that loader must use one DistributedSampler. Only DNA, attention mask, labels, and evidence tracks are moved to the device. """ from __future__ import annotations from dataclasses import dataclass import math from typing import Any import torch from torch.utils.data.distributed import DistributedSampler _PROJECTION_NAME = "transgenic.encoder.evidence_proj.weight" @dataclass(frozen=True)

nodes.name: MVPRecipe
nodes.body_text: class MVPRecipe: max_updates: int = 250 warmup_updates: int = 12 batch_size: int = 1 accumulation_steps: int = 24 required_world_size: int = 4 backbone_lr: float = 2e-5 projection_lr: float = 2e-4 weight_decay: float = 0.02 clip_grad_norm: float = 1.0 def __post_init__(self) -> None: for name in ("max_updates", "batch_size", "accumulation_steps", "required_world_size"): value = getattr(self, name) if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int): raise TypeError(f"{name} must be an integer") if value <= 0: raise ValueError(f"{name} must be positive") if isinstance(self.warmup_updates, bool) or not isinstance(self.warmup_updates, int): raise TypeError("warmup_updates must be an integer") if not 0 < self.warmup_updates < self.max_updates: raise ValueError("warmup_updates must be between zero and max_updates") for name in ("backbone_lr", "projection_lr", "clip_grad_norm"): value = getattr(self, name) if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)): raise TypeError(f"{name} must be numeric") if not math.isfinite(value) or value <= 0: raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite and positive") if (isinstance(self.weight_decay, bool) or not isinstance(self.weight_decay, (int, float))): raise TypeError("weight_decay must be numeric") if not math.isfinite(self.weight_decay) or self.weight_decay < 0: raise ValueError("weight_decay must be finite and nonnegative")

nodes.name: __post_init__
nodes.body_text: def __post_init__(self) -> None: for name in ("max_updates", "batch_size", "accumulation_steps", "required_world_size"): value = getattr(self, name) if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int): raise TypeError(f"{name} must be an integer") if value <= 0: raise ValueError(f"{name} must be positive") if isinstance(self.warmup_updates, bool) or not isinstance(self.warmup_updates, int): raise TypeError("warmup_updates must be an integer") if not 0 < self.warmup_updates < self.max_updates: raise ValueError("warmup_updates must be between zero and max_updates") for name in ("backbone_lr", "projection_lr", "clip_grad_norm"): value = getattr(self, name) if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)): raise TypeError(f"{name} must be numeric") if not math.isfinite(value) or value <= 0: raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite and positive") if (isinstance(self.weight_decay, bool) or not isinstance(self.weight_decay, (int, float))): raise TypeError("weight_decay must be numeric") if not math.isfinite(self.weight_decay) or self.weight_decay < 0: raise ValueError("weight_decay must be finite and nonnegative")

nodes.name: make_accelerator
nodes.body_text: def make_accelerator(recipe: MVPRecipe, **kwargs): """Construct an Accelerator with the fixed runtime's required DDP/accumulation semantics.""" from accelerate import Accelerator from accelerate.utils import DistributedDataParallelKwargs, GradientAccumulationPlugin handlers = list(kwargs.pop("kwargs_handlers", []) or []) ddp_handlers = [handler for handler in handlers if isinstance(handler, DistributedDataParallelKwargs)] if any(handler.find_unused_parameters is not True for handler in ddp_handlers): raise ValueError("DDP handler must set find_unused_parameters=True") if not ddp_handlers: handlers.append(DistributedDataParallelKwargs(find_unused_parameters=True)) plugin = GradientAccumulationPlugin( num_steps=recipe.accumulation_steps, sync_with_dataloader=False, adjust_scheduler=False, ) return Accelerator( gradient_accumulation_plugin=plugin, step_scheduler_with_optimizer=False, kwargs_handlers=handlers, **kwargs, )

nodes.name: build_optimizer
nodes.signature: def build_optimizer(model: torch.nn.Module, recipe: MVPRecipe) -> torch.optim.AdamW
nodes.body_text: def build_optimizer(model: torch.nn.Module, recipe: MVPRecipe) -> torch.optim.AdamW: """Build exhaustive, uniform-decay AdamW groups with one exact projection parameter.""" named = [(name, parameter) for name, parameter in model.named_parameters() if parameter.requires_grad] projection = [(name, parameter) for name, parameter in named if name == _PROJECTION_NAME] if len(projection) != 1: raise ValueError(f"expected exactly one trainable {_PROJECTION_NAME}, found {len(projection)}") if len({id(parameter) for _, parameter in named}) != len(named): raise ValueError("duplicate trainable parameters are not allowed") projection_parameter = projection[0][1] backbone = [parameter for name, parameter in named if name != _PROJECTION_NAME] if not backbone: raise ValueError("backbone optimizer group is empty") groups = [ {"name": "backbone", "params": backbone, "lr": recipe.backbone_lr, "weight_decay": recipe.weight_decay}, {"name": "projection", "params": [projection_parameter], "lr": recipe.projection_lr, "weight_decay": recipe.weight_decay}, ] grouped = [parameter for group in groups for parameter in group["params"]] if {id(parameter) for parameter in grouped} != {id(parameter) for _, parameter in named}: raise ValueError("optimizer groups leave trainable parameters unassigned") return torch.optim.AdamW(groups)

nodes.name: lr_scale
nodes.signature: def lr_scale(completed_updates: int, recipe: MVPRecipe) -> float
nodes.body_text: def lr_scale(completed_updates: int, recipe: MVPRecipe) -> float: """LambdaLR scale for ``completed_updates`` successful updates (post-step convention).""" if isinstance(completed_updates, bool) or not isinstance(completed_updates, int): raise TypeError("completed_updates must be an integer") if completed_updates < 0: raise ValueError("completed_updates must be nonnegative") if completed_updates < recipe.warmup_updates: return completed_updates / recipe.warmup_updates if completed_updates < recipe.max_updates: return ((recipe.max_updates - completed_updates) / (recipe.max_updates - recipe.warmup_updates)) return 0.0

nodes.name: _collective_true
nodes.body_text: def _collective_true(accelerator, condition: bool) -> bool: value = torch.tensor(int(condition), device=accelerator.device) return int(accelerator.reduce(value, reduction="sum").item()) == accelerator.num_processes

nodes.name: _all_ints
nodes.body_text: def _all_ints(accelerator, value: int) -> list[int]: tensor = torch.tensor([value], dtype=torch.int64, device=accelerator.device) return [int(item) for item in accelerator.gather(tensor).cpu().tolist()]

nodes.name: _set_lrs
nodes.signature: def _set_lrs(optimizer, recipe: MVPRecipe, completed_updates: int) -> None
nodes.body_text: def _set_lrs(optimizer, recipe: MVPRecipe, completed_updates: int) -> None: scale = lr_scale(completed_updates, recipe) for group, peak in zip(optimizer.param_groups, (recipe.backbone_lr, recipe.projection_lr)): group["lr"] = peak * scale

nodes.name: _step_was_skipped
nodes.body_text: def _step_was_skipped(optimizer) -> bool: """Narrow seam for exercising the AcceleratedOptimizer overflow result.""" return bool(getattr(optimizer, "step_was_skipped", False))

nodes.name: _validate_accelerator
nodes.signature: def _validate_accelerator(accelerator, model, optimizer, train_loader, recipe: MVPRecipe) -> None
nodes.body_text: def _validate_accelerator(accelerator, model, optimizer, train_loader, recipe: MVPRecipe) -> None: settings = accelerator.gradient_state.plugin_kwargs expected = {"num_steps": recipe.accumulation_steps, "sync_with_dataloader": False, "adjust_scheduler": False} errors = [] if any(settings.get(key) != value for key, value in expected.items()): errors.append(f"invalid gradient accumulation settings; expected {expected}") if accelerator.step_scheduler_with_optimizer is not False: errors.append("step_scheduler_with_optimizer must be False") if accelerator.num_processes != recipe.required_world_size: errors.append(f"world size {accelerator.num_processes} != required {recipe.required_world_size}") if getattr(accelerator, "_dataloaders", []): errors.append("caller must not prepare the dataloader") if optimizer not in getattr(accelerator, "_optimizers", []): errors.append("caller must prepare the optimizer") prepared_models = getattr(accelerator, "_models", []) unwrapped = accelerator.unwrap_model(model) if model not in prepared_models and unwrapped not in prepared_models: errors.append("caller must prepare the model") ddp_handler = getattr(accelerator, "ddp_handler", None) if ddp_handler is None or ddp_handler.find_unused_parameters is not True: errors.append("Accelerator DDP handler must set find_unused_parameters=True") if accelerator.num_processes > 1: from torch.nn.parallel import DistributedDataParallel if (not isinstance(model, DistributedDataParallel) or model.find_unused_parameters is not True): errors.append("prepared DDP model must set find_unused_parameters=True") sampler = getattr(train_loader, "sampler", None) if (not isinstance(sampler, DistributedSampler) or sampler.num_replicas != accelerator.num_processes or sampler.rank != accelerator.process_index): errors.append("DDP loader must have one rank-matched DistributedSampler") groups = optimizer.param_groups if len(groups) != 2 or [group.get("name") for group in groups] != ["backbone", "projection"]: errors.append("optimizer groups must be exactly ordered backbone, projection") else: named = [(name, parameter) for name, parameter in unwrapped.named_parameters() if parameter.requires_grad] projections = [parameter for name, parameter in named if name == _PROJECTION_NAME] backbone_params = groups[0].get("params") projection_params = groups[1].get("params") if not isinstance(backbone_params, (list, tuple)): errors.append("backbone optimizer group has no parameter list") backbone_params = [] if not isinstance(projection_params, (list, tuple)): errors.append("projection optimizer group has no parameter list") projection_params = [] grouped = list(backbone_params) + list(projection_params) grouped_ids = [id(parameter) for parameter in grouped] trainable_ids = {id(parameter) for _, parameter in named} if (len(projections) != 1 or len(projection_params) != 1 or projection_params[0] is not projections[0]): errors.append(f"projection group must contain exactly {_PROJECTION_NAME}") if (len(grouped_ids) != len(set(grouped_ids)) or set(grouped_ids) != trainable_ids): errors.append("optimizer groups must be disjoint and exhaustive") expected_backbone = {id(parameter) for name, parameter in named if name != _PROJECTION_NAME} if {id(parameter) for parameter in backbone_params} != expected_backbone: errors.append("backbone optimizer group contains unrelated or missing parameters") if any(group.get("weight_decay") != recipe.weight_decay for group in groups): errors.append("optimizer weight decay does not match recipe") if not _collective_true(accelerator, not errors): detail = "; ".join(errors) if errors else "invalid setting on another rank" raise ValueError(f"Accelerator ownership/settings invalid: {detail}")

nodes.name: _batch_parts
nodes.body_text: def _batch_parts(batch: Any, recipe: MVPRecipe): if not isinstance(batch, (tuple, list)) or len(batch) != 10: raise ValueError("training requires a collated 10-tuple batch") input_ids, attention_mask, labels, tracks = batch[0], batch[1], batch[2], batch[8] for name, value in (("DNA", input_ids), ("attention mask", attention_mask), ("labels", labels), ("evidence tracks", tracks)): if not isinstance(value, torch.Tensor) or value.ndim < 1: raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a batched tensor") if value.shape[0] != recipe.batch_size: raise ValueError(f"{name} batch size must equal {recipe.batch_size}") if (tracks.ndim != 3 or input_ids.ndim < 2 or tracks.shape != (*input_ids.shape, 8) or not tracks.is_floating_point()): raise ValueError("evidence tracks must be floating point (batch, DNA length, 8)") if attention_mask.shape != input_ids.shape: raise ValueError("attention mask must match DNA shape") return input_ids, attention_mask, labels, tracks

nodes.name: run_fixed_updates
nodes.signature: def run_fixed_updates(accelerator, model, optimizer, train_loader, recipe: MVPRecipe) -> dict
nodes.body_text: def run_fixed_updates(accelerator, model, optimizer, train_loader, recipe: MVPRecipe) -> dict: """Run exactly ``max_updates`` successful synchronized optimizer updates.""" _validate_accelerator(accelerator, model, optimizer, train_loader, recipe) try: local_loader_length = len(train_loader) except TypeError as error: raise ValueError("train loader must have a finite length") from error loader_lengths = _all_ints(accelerator, local_loader_length) if any(length <= 0 for length in loader_lengths) or len(set(loader_lengths)) != 1: raise ValueError(f"per-rank loader lengths must be equal and nonempty: {loader_lengths}") model.train() optimizer.zero_grad() _set_lrs(optimizer, recipe, 0) completed = microbatches = epoch = 0 lr_trace = [] if len(set(_all_ints(accelerator, completed))) != 1: raise RuntimeError("startup successful-update counters diverged") while completed < recipe.max_updates: sampler = getattr(train_loader, "sampler", None) if hasattr(sampler, "set_epoch"): sampler.set_epoch(epoch) for batch in train_loader: with accelerator.accumulate(model): try: parts = _batch_parts(batch, recipe) batch_valid = True except (TypeError, ValueError): parts, batch_valid = None, False if not _collective_true(accelerator, batch_valid): raise ValueError("invalid batch contract on at least one rank") input_ids, attention_mask, labels, tracks = ( value.to(accelerator.device) for value in parts ) output = model(input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask, labels=labels, evidence_tracks=tracks) loss = getattr(output, "loss", None) loss_finite = (isinstance(loss, torch.Tensor) and loss.numel() == 1 and bool(torch.isfinite(loss.detach()).item())) if not _collective_true(accelerator, loss_finite): raise FloatingPointError("nonfinite loss on at least one rank") accelerator.backward(loss) microbatches += 1 if accelerator.sync_gradients: gradients_finite = all( parameter.grad is None or bool(torch.isfinite(parameter.grad).all().item()) for parameter in model.parameters() ) if not _collective_true(accelerator, gradients_finite): optimizer.zero_grad() raise FloatingPointError("nonfinite gradients on at least one rank") accelerator.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), recipe.clip_grad_norm) used_lrs = [float(group["lr"]) for group in optimizer.param_groups] optimizer.step() skipped = not _collective_true(accelerator, not _step_was_skipped(optimizer)) optimizer.zero_grad() if skipped: raise RuntimeError("optimizer step skipped on at least one rank") completed += 1 lr_trace.append({"update": completed, "backbone": used_lrs[0], "projection": used_lrs[1]}) if len(set(_all_ints(accelerator, completed))) != 1: raise RuntimeError("successful-update counters diverged") _set_lrs(optimizer, recipe, completed) if completed == recipe.max_updates: break if completed < recipe.max_updates: epoch += 1 microbatch_counts = _all_ints(accelerator, microbatches) if len(set(_all_ints(accelerator, completed))) != 1: raise RuntimeError("final successful-update counters diverged") return { "successful_updates": completed, "microbatches_per_rank": microbatch_counts, "epochs_crossed": epoch, "effective_batch_size": (recipe.batch_size * recipe.accumulation_steps * accelerator.num_processes), "lr_trace": lr_trace, "final_lrs": [float(group["lr"]) for group in optimizer.param_groups], }

nodes.name: weights_init.py
nodes.body_text: """Audited, weights-only B5 (0 evidence channels) to MVP (8 channels) initialization. ``load_weights_only`` mutates the caller's fresh, unwrapped model. Every failure marks that target ``_weights_init_poisoned = True`` because a failed safetensors load may already have copied some parameters. Callers must discard such a target; this helper provides no rollback and is not resume support. """ from __future__ import annotations import hashlib import json import os import stat from pathlib import Path from typing import Any import torch from safetensors import safe_open from safetensors.torch import load_model from transgenic.model.configuration_transgenic import HyenaTransgenicConfig from transgenic.model import configuration_transgenic from transgenic.training import b5_runtime from transgenic.training.b5_runtime import REQUIRED_CONFIG_KEYS, model_kwargs _SCHEMA_VERSION = "b6-weights-init-v1" _PROJECTION_KEY = "transgenic.encoder.evidence_proj.weight" _REQUIRED_RECIPE_KEYS = set(REQUIRED_CONFIG_KEYS) | {"encoder_n_layer"} # These fields determine serialized layout or behavior used by the current # constructor/forward path (encoder, LED decoder, generation, tying and heads). _SEMANTIC_FIELDS = ( "vocab_size", "max_encoder_position_embeddings", "max_decoder_position_embeddings", "encoder_layers", "encoder_ffn_dim", "encoder_attention_heads", "decoder_layers", "decoder_ffn_dim", "decoder_attention_heads", "encoder_layerdrop", "decoder_layerdrop", "use_cache", "is_encoder_decoder", "activation_function", "d_model", "encoder_d_model", "decoder_d_model", "dropout", "attention_dropout", "activation_dropout", "classifier_dropout", "init_std", "decoder_start_token_id", "pad_token_id", "bos_token_id", "eos_token_id", "attention_window", "encoder_model", "max_encoder_seqlen", "encoder_n_layer", "unlink", "max_transcript_count", "evidence_channels", "tie_word_embeddings", "return_dict", "output_attentions", "output_hidden_states", "torchscript", "scale_embedding", "normalize_before", "layer_norm_eps", ) _MAPPED_FROM = { "d_model": "d_model_encoder", "encoder_d_model": "d_model_encoder", "decoder_d_model": "d_model_decoder", }

nodes.name: _canonical
nodes.body_text: def _canonical(value: Any) -> bytes: return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")

nodes.name: _sha256_bytes
nodes.body_text: def _sha256_bytes(data: bytes) -> str: return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

nodes.name: _snapshot
nodes.body_text: def _snapshot(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]: info = path.stat() digest = hashlib.sha256() with path.open("rb") as handle: for block in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""): digest.update(block) return { "sha256": digest.hexdigest(), "size": info.st_size, "device": info.st_dev, "inode": info.st_ino, "mtime_ns": info.st_mtime_ns, }

nodes.name: _regular_file
nodes.signature: def _regular_file(path: Path, parent: Path, label: str) -> Path
nodes.body_text: def _regular_file(path: Path, parent: Path, label: str) -> Path: resolved = path.resolve(strict=True) if resolved.parent != parent or not stat.S_ISREG(resolved.stat().st_mode): raise ValueError(f"{label} must be a regular file at its canonical checkpoint root") return resolved

nodes.name: _resolve
nodes.body_text: def _resolve(init_from: os.PathLike[str] | str) -> tuple[Path, Path]: requested = Path(init_from) resolved = requested.resolve(strict=True) if resolved.is_dir(): checkpoint = resolved weights = _regular_file(checkpoint / "model.safetensors", checkpoint, "weights") else: if requested.name != "model.safetensors" or resolved.name != "model.safetensors": raise ValueError("the exact weights filename must be model.safetensors") checkpoint = requested.parent.resolve(strict=True) if resolved.parent != checkpoint: raise ValueError("weights must be a regular file at its canonical checkpoint root") weights = _regular_file(requested, checkpoint, "weights") return checkpoint, weights

nodes.name: _json_file
nodes.body_text: def _json_file(path: Path) -> Any: with path.open(encoding="utf-8") as handle: return json.load(handle)

nodes.name: _value
nodes.body_text: def _value(value: Any) -> Any: if isinstance(value, tuple): return [_value(item) for item in value] if isinstance(value, list): return [_value(item) for item in value] if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool)) or value is None: return value raise TypeError(f"semantic value is not JSON-serializable: {value!r}")

nodes.signature: def _manifest(config: Any, recipe: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]
nodes.body_text: def _manifest(config: Any, recipe: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]: fields: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {} kwargs = model_kwargs(recipe) if recipe is not None else {} for name in _SEMANTIC_FIELDS: if not hasattr(config, name): continue if recipe is None: provenance = "target-config" elif name in recipe: provenance = "recipe-explicit" elif name in _MAPPED_FROM: provenance = "mapping-derived" elif name in kwargs: provenance = "mapping-derived" else: provenance = "config-default" fields[name] = {"value": _value(getattr(config, name)), "provenance": provenance} return fields

nodes.signature: def _check_equal(source: dict[str, dict[str, Any]], target: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> None
nodes.body_text: def _check_equal(source: dict[str, dict[str, Any]], target: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> None: names = (set(source) | set(target)) - {"evidence_channels"} for name in sorted(names): source_value = source.get(name, {}).get("value", "<absent>") target_value = target.get(name, {}).get("value", "<absent>") if source_value != target_value: raise ValueError(f"source/target semantic mismatch for {name}: {source_value!r} != {target_value!r}")

nodes.name: load_weights_only
nodes.signature: def load_weights_only(model: torch.nn.Module, init_from: os.PathLike[str] | str) -> dict[str, Any]
nodes.body_text: def load_weights_only(model: torch.nn.Module, init_from: os.PathLike[str] | str) -> dict[str, Any]: """Load only a canonical B5 ``model.safetensors`` into an 8-channel model. The sole compatibility exception is evidence channels 0 -> 8; the missing projection is zeroed. Same-8 initialization is deliberately unsupported. No optimizer, scheduler, pending-gradient or RNG state is read. Any raised exception poisons ``model``; discard it even when validation failed early. """ if getattr(model, "_weights_init_poisoned", False): raise ValueError("weights-only target was poisoned by an earlier failed load; discard it") model._weights_init_poisoned = True requested = os.fspath(init_from) checkpoint, weights = _resolve(init_from) if any(parameter.grad is not None for parameter in model.parameters()): raise ValueError("weights-only target must not have preexisting grads") target_config = getattr(model, "config", None) if target_config is None or getattr(target_config, "evidence_channels", None) != 8: raise ValueError("weights-only target evidence_channels must be 8") run_root = checkpoint.parent run_config_path = _regular_file(run_root / "run_config.json", run_root, "run_config.json") runtime_identity = run_root / "runtime_identity.txt" paths: dict[str, Path | None] = { "model.safetensors": weights, "run_config.json": run_config_path, "runtime_identity.txt": ( _regular_file(runtime_identity, run_root, "runtime_identity.txt") if os.path.lexists(runtime_identity) else None ), } for name in ("config.json", "meta.json", "runtime.json"): candidate = checkpoint / name if os.path.lexists(candidate): paths[name] = _regular_file(candidate, checkpoint, name) else: paths[name] = None before = {name: _snapshot(path) for name, path in paths.items() if path is not None} run_config = _json_file(run_config_path) if not isinstance(run_config, dict) or not isinstance(run_config.get("recipe"), dict): raise ValueError("parent run_config.json must contain an embedded normalized recipe") recipe = run_config["recipe"] missing_recipe = sorted(_REQUIRED_RECIPE_KEYS - set(recipe)) if missing_recipe: raise ValueError(f"embedded normalized recipe missing keys {missing_recipe}") source_channels = recipe.get("evidence_channels", 0) if source_channels != 0 or isinstance(source_channels, bool): raise ValueError("only the evidence_channels 0->8 transition is supported; same-8 is deferred") source_config = HyenaTransgenicConfig(**model_kwargs(recipe)) source_fields = _manifest(source_config, recipe) target_fields = _manifest(target_config, None) # model_kwargs is intentionally the historical B5 mapping. If a recipe has # additional known semantic keys, they may attest defaults but not override it. for name in _SEMANTIC_FIELDS: if name in recipe and name != "evidence_channels" and hasattr(source_config, name): if _value(recipe[name]) != _value(getattr(source_config, name)): raise ValueError(f"recipe semantic {name} contradicts the reconstructed B5 default") _check_equal(source_fields, target_fields) config_path = paths["config.json"] if config_path is not None: recorded_config = _json_file(config_path) if not isinstance(recorded_config, dict): raise ValueError("config.json must contain an object") for name, entry in source_fields.items(): if name in recorded_config and _value(recorded_config[name]) != entry["value"]: raise ValueError(f"config.json semantic mismatch for {name}") target_state = model.state_dict() tied_keys = ( "lm_head.weight", "transgenic.decoder_embed_tokens.weight", "transgenic.decoder.embed_tokens.weight", ) if not all(key in target_state for key in tied_keys): raise ValueError(f"target is missing required tied storage keys: {tied_keys}") storages = {(target_state[key].untyped_storage().data_ptr(), target_state[key].storage_offset()) for key in tied_keys} if len(storages) != 1: raise ValueError("target decoder embeddings and LM head must use actual tied storage") with safe_open(weights, framework="pt", device="cpu") as handle: file_keys = set(handle.keys()) safetensors_metadata = handle.metadata() if _PROJECTION_KEY in file_keys: raise ValueError("source checkpoint must not contain an evidence projection") unexpected_preflight = sorted(file_keys - set(target_state)) if unexpected_preflight: raise ValueError(f"unexpected safetensors keys: {unexpected_preflight}") for key in sorted(file_keys): shape = tuple(handle.get_slice(key).get_shape()) if shape != tuple(target_state[key].shape): raise ValueError(f"shape mismatch for {key}: {shape} != {tuple(target_state[key].shape)}") missing, unexpected = load_model(model, weights, strict=False, device="cpu") missing, unexpected = sorted(missing), sorted(unexpected) if missing != [_PROJECTION_KEY] or unexpected: raise ValueError(f"weights load refused: missing={missing}, unexpected={unexpected}") projection = model.get_parameter(_PROJECTION_KEY) with torch.no_grad(): projection.zero_() if torch.count_nonzero(projection).item() != 0: raise RuntimeError("evidence projection zero verification faile

nodes.name: gsf.py
nodes.body_text: """ GSF (Gene Sentence Format) Utilities for TransGenic. GSF is TransGenic's custom compact annotation format used to represent gene structures as concise strings suitable for sequence-to-annotation model output. GSF Format Overview: A GSF string has the structure: feature_list>transcript_list Feature List: A semicolon-separated list of features, where each feature is a pipe-delimited tuple of five fields: start|type|end|strand|phase - start: 0-indexed start coordinate relative to the input sequence - type: feature identifier (e.g., CDS1, CDS2, five_prime_UTR1, three_prime_UTR1) - end: 0-indexed end coordinate relative to the input sequence - strand: "+" for forward strand, "-" for reverse strand - phase: reading frame offset encoded as A (0), B (1), C (2), or "." (not applicable, used for UTRs) Transcript List: A semicolon-separated list of transcripts, where each transcript is a pipe-delimited list of feature type references (e.g., CDS1|CDS2|CDS3). Multiple alternative transcripts are separated by semicolons. Example: 100|CDS1|200|+|A;200|CDS2|400|+|B;50|five_prime_UTR1|100|+|.>CDS1|CDS2|five_prime_UTR1 This module provides utilities for: - Transforming GSF strings for reverse-complemented sequences - Converting GSF strings to standard GFF3 format for use with bioinformatics tools """ import re, sys from typing import List, Optional, Tuple

nodes.name: reverseComplement_gffString
nodes.body_text: def reverseComplement_gffString(gff, length): """ Transform a GSF string's coordinates and strand for a reverse-complemented sequence. When a genomic sequence is reverse-complemented, all annotations must be transformed accordingly: coordinates are mirrored, strands are flipped, and the order of features is rearranged because the 5'-to-3' direction reverses. Specifically, this function: - Re-orders features so that CDS, five_prime_UTR, and three_prime_UTR features are swapped in positional order (since what was the 5' end becomes the 3' end and vice versa). - Flips coordinates using: new_start = length - old_end, new_end = length - old_start. - Swaps strand orientation: "+" becomes "-", "-" becomes "+". - Reverses the order of CDS features within each transcript, since the 5'-to-3' reading direction is inverted by reverse complementation. Args: gff (str): A GSF-formatted string (feature_list>transcript_list). length (int): The length of the sequence, used for coordinate transformation (new_coord = length - old_coord). Returns: str: A new GSF-formatted string with transformed coordinates, flipped strands, and reordered features appropriate for the reverse complement of the original sequence. """ # Split the GSF string into its two major components: # feature_list (individual genomic features) and mRNA_list (transcript definitions) feature_list, mRNA_list = gff.split('>') features = feature_list.split(';') # Build a reordering index that determines how features should be rearranged # after reverse complementation. The insertion positions (begin_cds, begin_utr5, # begin_utr3) track where each feature type should be placed in the new order. # This effectively swaps the positional ordering of CDS, 5'UTR, and 3'UTR # features since the 5'->3' direction reverses on the complementary strand. order = [] begin_cds = 0 begin_utr5 = 0 begin_utr3 = 0 phase_lookup = {} for i, feature in enumerate(features): if "CDS" in feature: # Insert CDS at its current insertion point; advance the UTR insertion points order.insert(begin_cds, i) begin_utr5 = i+1 begin_utr3 = i+1 # Record the phase (reading frame) for each CDS, keyed by feature type ID phase_lookup[feature.split("|")[1]] = feature.split("|")[4] elif "five_prime_UTR" in feature: # Insert 5'UTR at its current insertion point; advance CDS and 3'UTR points order.insert(begin_utr5, i) begin_cds = i+1 begin_utr3 = i+1 elif "three_prime_UTR" in feature: # Insert 3'UTR at its current insertion point; advance CDS and 5'UTR points order.insert(begin_utr3, i) begin_cds = i+1 begin_utr5 = i+1 # Parse each feature into its five component fields: [start, type, end, strand, phase] features = [feature.split('|') for feature in features] new_features = [] # Maps old feature type IDs to new ones after reordering (e.g., CDS1 -> CDS3) feature_swap = {} for index, i in enumerate(order): # Mirror coordinates: new_start = length - old_end, new_end = length - old_start old_start = int(features[i][0]) old_end = int(features[i][2]) new_start = str(int(length) - old_end) new_end = str(int(length) - old_start) # The feature type ID is taken from the feature at the current index position, # not from the reordered feature -- this reassigns type labels to maintain # sequential numbering in the new order (e.g., CDS1 stays first in the list) new_type = features[index][1] # Record the mapping from old type ID to new type ID for transcript rewriting feature_swap[features[i][1]] = new_type phase = features[i][4] # Flip strand orientation: + becomes -, - becomes + if features[i][3] == "-": new_strand = "+" elif features[i][3] == "+": new_strand = "-" new_features.append([new_start, new_type, new_end, new_strand, phase]) # Rebuild transcript definitions using the feature type mapping. # CDS order within each transcript is reversed (insert at position 0) because # the 5'->3' reading direction flips on the reverse complement strand. transcripts = [t.split("|") for t in mRNA_list.split(';')] new_transcripts = [] for transcript in transcripts: new_utrs = [] new_cds = [] phase = '' for feature in transcript: if "UTR" in feature: # UTR features are appended in their encountered order new_utrs.append(feature_swap[feature]) else: # CDS features are prepended (insert at 0) to reverse their order, # reflecting the reversed reading direction on the complementary strand new_cds.insert(0, feature_swap[feature]) phase += phase_lookup[feature] # Concatenate reversed CDS list followed by UTRs for the new transcript new_transcripts.append(new_cds + new_utrs) # Reassemble the GSF string: features joined by ; with fields joined by |, # separated from transcripts by > return f"{';'.join(['|'.join(feature) for feature in new_features])}>{';'.join(['|'.join(transcript) for transcript in new_transcripts])}"

nodes.name: get_cds_fingerprint
nodes.body_text: def get_cds_fingerprint(gff_lines: List[str]) -> Optional[Tuple]: """ Generate a fingerprint from a GFF3 gene prediction for deduplication. Builds a per-transcript fingerprint from CDS coordinates grouped by their parent mRNA. Two predictions are duplicates when they share the same chromosome, strand, and identical set of per-transcript CDS intervals. For genes without CDS features (e.g. UTR-only), the mRNA boundaries are used instead so that they are still eligible for deduplication. Args: gff_lines: List of GFF3-formatted lines from gffString2GFF3(). Returns: A hashable tuple that uniquely identifies the gene structure, or None if no parseable features are found. """ strand = None chrom = None # CDS coords keyed by parent mRNA ID transcript_cds = {} # mRNA boundaries as fallback for CDS-less genes mrna_bounds = {} for line in gff_lines: cols = line.split("\t") if len(cols) < 9: continue feat_type = cols[2] if feat_type == "gene": chrom = cols[0] strand = cols[6] elif feat_type == "mRNA": attrs = cols[8] mid = attrs.split("ID=")[1].split(";")[0] if "ID=" in attrs else None if mid: mrna_bounds[mid] = (int(cols[3]), int(cols[4])) elif feat_type == "CDS": attrs = cols[8] parent = attrs.split("Parent=")[1].split(";")[0] if "Parent=" in attrs else None if parent: transcript_cds.setdefault(parent, []).append((int(cols[3]), int(cols[4]))) if chrom is None: return None if transcript_cds: # Sorted tuple of per-transcript CDS sets (each transcript's CDS sorted) per_tx = tuple(sorted( tuple(sorted(coords)) for coords in transcript_cds.values() )) return (chrom, strand, per_tx) # Fallback: no CDS, use mRNA boundaries if mrna_bounds: bounds = tuple(sorted(mrna_bounds.values())) return (chrom, strand, bounds) return None

nodes.name: get_utr_span
nodes.body_text: def get_utr_span(gff_lines: List[str]) -> int: """ Calculate total UTR span (in bases) from GFF3 gene prediction lines. Sums the length of all five_prime_UTR and three_prime_UTR features. Used to break ties when two predictions share the same CDS fingerprint: the prediction with longer UTR coverage is preferred because it captures more of the gene's regulatory regions. Args: gff_lines: List of GFF3-formatted lines from gffString2GFF3(). Returns: Total UTR span in bases (0 if no UTR features are present). """ total = 0 for line in gff_lines: cols = line.split("\t") if len(cols) >= 9 and "UTR" in cols[2]: total += int(cols[4]) - int(cols[3]) + 1 return total

nodes.name: dedup_gff3_file
nodes.body_text:
def dedup_gff3_file(output_path: str) -> int: """ Remove superseded gene blocks from a GFF3 file, keeping the last occurrence of each CDS fingerprint (which has the longest UTR). This is a post-hoc cleanup pass for the streaming write design: during inference, a prediction with longer UTR replaces the fingerprint entry but both versions exist in the file. This pass removes the older ones. Args: output_path: Path to the GFF3 output file to deduplicate in-place. Returns: Number of superseded gene blocks removed. """ gene_blocks = [] current_block = [] header_lines = [] with open(output_path) as f: for line in f: line = line.rstrip("
") if line.startswith("#"): header_lines.append(line) continue cols = line.split("	") if len(cols) >= 9 and cols[2] == "gene": if current_block: gene_blocks.append(current_block) current_block = [line] elif len(cols) >= 9: current_block.append(line) if current_block: gene_blocks.append(current_block) # For each fingerprint, the last occurrence has the longest UTR # (guaranteed by the caller logic that only writes a replacement # when the new UTR is strictly longer). last_occurrence = {} for i, block in enumerate(gene_blocks): fp = get_cds_fingerprint(block) if fp is not None: last_occurrence[fp] = i removed = 0 with open(output_path, "w") as f: for line in header_lines: f.write(line + "
") for i, block in enumerate(gene_blocks): fp = get_cds_fingerprint(block) if fp is None or last_occurrence[fp] == i: for line in block: f.write(line + "
") else: removed += 1 return removed

nodes.name: gffString2GFF3
nodes.signature: def gffString2GFF3(gff:str, chr:str, region_start:int, extra_attributes:str) -> List[str]
nodes.body_text: def gffString2GFF3(gff:str, chr:str, region_start:int, extra_attributes:str) -> List[str]: """ Convert a GSF string (decoded model output) to standard GFF3 format. Translates TransGenic's compact GSF annotation format into GFF3, the widely used tab-delimited format for genome annotations understood by bioinformatics tools (e.g., genome browsers, gene prediction pipelines). The conversion involves: - Stripping special tokens (<s>, </s>) that may be present from the model decoder output. - Converting 0-indexed relative coordinates (within the input sequence) to 1-indexed absolute genomic coordinates using the region_start offset. - Mapping encoded phase values to GFF3 phase: A->0, B->1, C->2, "."->"." - Generating unique UUIDs for hierarchical gene/mRNA/feature identifiers. - Constructing a proper GFF3 hierarchy: gene -> mRNA -> CDS/UTR features, linked via ID/Parent attributes. - Handling malformed features gracefully by skipping invalid entries and continuing with valid ones wherever possible. Args: gff (str): A GSF-formatted string (feature_list>transcript_list), potentially containing special tokens from model output. chr (str): The chromosome or scaffold name for the GFF3 seqid column. region_start (int): The 0-indexed start position of the input sequence region within the chromosome. Used to convert relative feature coordinates to absolute genomic coordinates. extra_attributes (str): Additional GFF3 attribute key=value pairs to append to every feature line (e.g., "source=model_v1"). Returns: list[str]: A list of GFF3-formatted tab-separated strings, one per annotation line. The list follows the hierarchy: gene line first, then mRNA lines, then CDS/UTR feature lines for each mRNA. Returns [""] if the GSF string cannot be parsed or contains no valid transcripts. """ # Phase encoding lookup: GSF uses A/B/C to represent GFF3 phases 0/1/2 # (the number of bases to skip at the start of a CDS feature to reach the # first complete codon). "." means phase is not applicable (e.g., UTRs). phaseLookup = {"A":0,"B":1,"C":2,".":"."} # Strip special tokens that may remain from the model's decoder output. # <s> is the start-of-sequence token; </s> is the end-of-sequence token. # The "|</s>" variant handles cases where </s> is pipe-delimited with a feature. gff = gff.replace ("<s>", "").replace("|</s>", "").replace("</s>", "") # Convert from 0-indexed (model output) to 1-indexed (GFF3 convention) # by incrementing region_start; this offset is added to all feature coordinates later. region_start += 1 # Parse the GSF string into features and transcripts. # Build a dictionary of features keyed by their type ID (e.g., "CDS1", "CDS2") # for quick lookup when processing transcripts. try: features,transcripts = gff.split(">") features = [feat.split("|") for feat in features.split(";")] # Key features by their type ID (field index 1, e.g., "CDS1") for lookup features = {feat[1]:feat for feat in features} transcripts = transcripts.split(";") # Determine the gene strand from the first CDS feature (CDS1) geneStrand = features["CDS1"][3] except: # If parsing fails (e.g., malformed GSF, missing ">", missing CDS1), # report the error and return an empty result print(f"Error parsing GFF string, skipping.\n{gff}", file=sys.stderr) return [""] # Determine the genomic bounds (start, end) for each transcript by iterating # over all referenced features and tracking the min start and max end. # Invalid or missing features are skipped gracefully rather than aborting. validTranscripts = [] transcriptBounds = [] for transcript in transcripts: geneStart = None geneEnd = None validFeats = [] for feat in transcript.split("|"): if feat not in features: # Feature referenced in transcript but not defined in feature list -- skip it continue # Validate that the feature has all 5 required fields: start|type|end|strand|phase featureData = features[feat] if len(featureData) < 5: print(f"Warning: malformed feature '{feat}' has {len(featureData)} elements, expected 5. Skipping.", file=sys.stderr) continue # Validate that start and end coordinates are valid integers try: featStart = int(featureData[0]) featEnd = int(featureData[2]) except ValueError: print(f"Warning: feature '{feat}' has non-integer coordinates: start='{featureData[0]}', end='{featureData[2]}'. Skipping.", file=sys.stderr) continue # Reject features with flipped coordinates (start >= end) if featStart >= featEnd: print(f"Warning: feature '{feat}' has flipped/zero-length coordinates: start={featStart}, end={featEnd}. Skipping.", file=sys.stderr) continue # Reject features with negative coordinates if featStart < 0: print(f"Warning: feature '{feat}' has negative start coordinate: {featStart}. Skipping.", file=sys.stderr) continue # Reject CDS features shorter than 3bp (sub-codon) if 'CDS' in feat and (featEnd - featStart) < 3: print(f"Warning: CDS feature '{feat}' is shorter than 3bp ({featEnd - featStart}bp). Skipping.", file=sys.stderr) continue validFeats.append(feat) # Track the minimum s

nodes.name: gsf_contract.py
nodes.body_text: """GSF contract implementation — docs/gsf_spec_v1.md (v1.0, frozen 2026-09-02). Pure Python, no torch/numpy. Loaded by path from tests/conftest.py and imported by the production builder (preprocess.py / gff2gsf.py) once #12 lands. Covers: coordinates (§1), grammar (§2), canonical ordering gsf-order-v1 (§3), caps (§4), reverse complement (§5), DB row contract (§6), split table (§7), and the C2 label/weight contract (§10, protocol A18.4). """ from __future__ import annotations import math import random import re from dataclasses import dataclass, field from typing import Dict, Iterable, Iterator, List, Optional, Sequence, Set, Tuple WINDOW_UNIT = 6144 MAX_WINDOW = 49152 # sym6144-v1 (published recipe) WINDOW_TIERS = (30720, 61440, 129024) # tier6144-v2: 5, 10, 21 chunks (~32 / 64 / 128 kb); Helixer plant context is 106,920 MAX_WINDOW_V2 = WINDOW_TIERS[-1] MIN_FLANK = 1000 # nt of context required on each side of the gene before a tier is accepted TIER_UP_PROB = 0.3 # augmentation: probability of using the next larger tier (training builds only) CAPS = {"CDS": 150, "five_prime_UTR": 50, "three_prime_UTR": 50, "transcripts": 15, "tokens": 2048} ORDERING_VERSION = "gsf-order-v1" WINDOW_POLICY = "sym6144-v1" WINDOW_POLICY_V2 = "tier6144-v2" BUILD_VERSION = "gsf-contract-v1" TILE_BUILD_VERSION = "gsf-contract-a40-v1" # replacement tile corpus; A40 review pending PHASE_TO_LETTER = {0: "A", 1: "B", 2: "C"} LETTER_TO_PHASE = {v: k for k, v in PHASE_TO_LETTER.items()} FEATURE_TYPES = ("five_prime_UTR", "CDS", "three_prime_UTR") RC_MODES = ("none", "all", "isoform-only") GENE_SEP = "<gene>" # v3: separates gene blocks inside one window label EMPTY_LABEL = "<empty>" # v3: window without any complete gene CAPS_V3 = {"tokens": 8192, "genes": 96} # from tile statistics (A. thaliana 129-kb tiles: p95 42 genes, max 80, ~120 tokens/gene) WINDOW_POLICY_V3 = "tile6144-v3" EMPTY_KEEP_PROB = 0.1 BLOCK_LEN = 8 * 129024 # 1,032,192 nt: genomic blocks that carry the tile split (A29) LEAK_MASK_FLANK = 100 # nt of N on each side of a leak-masked gene (A29; A33 draws it from FLANK_RANGE) # --- A33 parameters, fixed from the nine reference annotations before the B5 build --- FLANK_RANGE = (50, 150) # seeded uniform flank per masked component (A33.3) MASK_FRACTION_MAX = 0.60 # train/valid tile dropped above this masked-base fraction (above the p95 of every tier) DECOY_RATIO = 1.0 / 3.0 # decoy rate = min(DECOY_MAX, species mask rate * DECOY_RATIO), train tiles only DECOY_MAX = 0.05 EDGE_MARGIN = 1000 # A27 inference-side acceptance margin; A33.4 invariant ties it to the three offsets STITCH_RECIPROCAL = 0.90 # same-locus test for non-identical same-strand predictions (A33.2) STITCH_MONO_END = 1000 # mono-exon pairs: both ends within this distance SEG_CLASSES = ["protein_coding_gene", "lncRNA", "exon", "intron", "splice_donor", "splice_acceptor", "5UTR", "3UTR", "CTCF-bound", "polyA_signal", "enhancer_Tissue_specific", "enhancer_Tissue_invariant", "promoter_Tissue_specific", "promoter_Tissue_invariant"] SOURCE_WEIGHT = {"protein": 1.0, "pacbio": 1.0, "ont": 0.8, "est": 0.6} # exon/UTR family (A18.4) JUNCTION_SOURCE_WEIGHT = {"est": 1.0, "pacbio": 0.9, "ont": 0.7, "protein": 0.5} # intron/boundary family (A20) JUNCTION_FAMILY = ("intron", "splice_donor", "splice_acceptor") WEIGHT_CAP = 4.0 RETAINED_INTRON_WEIGHT = 0.25 @dataclass(frozen=True) @dataclass MAX_KEY_LEN = 10 # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- # §1 coordinates # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- # GFF3 parsing (EOF flush, per-gene chromosome/strand ownership) # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- _ATTR_RE = re.compile(r"([^;=]+)=([^;]*)") # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- # §2/§3 canonical serialisation # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- # §5 reverse complement (pure transformation, phases recomputed 5'->3') # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- # §4 caps and v2 token counting # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- # §6 DB rows # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- # §7 split table # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- # §10 C2 labels and weights (protocol A18.4) # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- _CLASS = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(SEG_CLASSES)} _TYPE_CLASSES = { "CDS": ("exon", "protein_coding_gene"), "exon": ("exon",), "intron": ("intron",), "five_prime_UTR": ("exon", "5UTR", "protein_coding_gene"), "three_prime_UTR": ("exon", "3UTR", "protein_coding_gene"), } # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- # GSF v3: every complete gene inside a window (author decision 2026-09-02, protocol A26) # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- SPLIT_RANK = {"train": 0, "valid": 1, "test": 2}

nodes.name: CapError
nodes.body_text: class CapError(ValueError): """A record exceeds a frozen cap (§4). Records are rejected, never truncated."""

nodes.name: SplitError
nodes.body_text: class SplitError(KeyError): """A gene has no entry in the split table (§7): builders fail closed."""

nodes.name: Feature
nodes.body_text: class Feature: type: str start1: int # GFF3 1-based inclusive end1: int phase: str # "0"/"1"/"2" for CDS, "." otherwise

nodes.name: Gene
nodes.body_text: class Gene: gene_id: str chrom: str strand: str start0: int end0: int transcripts: Dict[str, List[Feature]] = field(default_factory=dict) gene_id_original: str = "" # GFF ID attribute verbatim name_original: str = "" # GFF Name attribute verbatim

nodes.name: species_code
nodes.body_text: def species_code(species_id: str) -> str: """Three-letter species code: first three characters of the manifest species_id (e.g. Athaliana -> Ath).""" return (species_id[:3] or "Unk").capitalize() if not species_id[:3].isupper() else species_id[:3]

nodes.name: key_is_valid
nodes.body_text: def key_is_valid(key: str) -> bool: return 0 < len(key) <= MAX_KEY_LEN and key.count(".") <= 1

nodes.name: gene_key
nodes.signature: def gene_key(species_code_: str, gff_id: str, gff_name: str, counter: int) -> str
nodes.body_text: def gene_key(species_code_: str, gff_id: str, gff_name: str, counter: int) -> str: """Author rule (2026-09-02): ID first, then Name; a candidate longer than 10 characters or with more than one dot, or no candidate at all, becomes <3-letter species code><6-digit ordinal in GFF order>.""" cand = gff_id or gff_name if cand and key_is_valid(cand): return cand return f"{species_code_}{counter:06d}"

nodes.name: pad_window_tiered
nodes.signature: def pad_window_tiered(start0: int, end0: int, rng: Optional["random.Random"] = None, tier_up_prob: float = 0.0, tiers: Sequence[int] = WINDOW_TIERS, min_flank: int = MIN_FLANK) -> Tuple[int, int, int]
nodes.body_text: def pad_window_tiered(start0: int, end0: int, rng: Optional["random.Random"] = None, tier_up_prob: float = 0.0, tiers: Sequence[int] = WINDOW_TIERS, min_flank: int = MIN_FLANK) -> Tuple[int, int, int]: """tier6144-v2: the smallest tier that holds the gene plus MIN_FLANK on both sides; with `rng` and tier_up_prob the next tier is chosen instead (variable-context augmentation) and the gene is placed at a random offset inside it. Returns (ws, we, tier). Genes longer than the largest tier minus flanks are rejected by the caller via CapError (window > MAX_WINDOW_V2).""" length = end0 - start0 idx = next((i for i, t in enumerate(tiers) if length + 2 * min_flank <= t), None) if idx is None: we_ws = tiers[-1] return start0 - min_flank, start0 - min_flank + we_ws + WINDOW_UNIT, tiers[-1] + WINDOW_UNIT # over cap -> rejected downstream if rng is not None and tier_up_prob > 0 and idx + 1 < len(tiers) and rng.random() < tier_up_prob: idx += 1 tier = tiers[idx] slack = tier - length left = slack // 2 if rng is None else rng.randint(min_flank, slack - min_flank) ws = start0 - left we = ws + tier if ws < 0: we -= ws ws = 0 return ws, we, tier

nodes.name: pad_window
nodes.signature: def pad_window(start0: int, end0: int) -> Tuple[int, int]
nodes.body_text: def pad_window(start0: int, end0: int) -> Tuple[int, int]: """Symmetric padding to a multiple of WINDOW_UNIT; no extra chunk at exact multiples.""" length = end0 - start0 pad = (WINDOW_UNIT - length % WINDOW_UNIT) % WINDOW_UNIT left = pad // 2 right = pad - left ws, we = start0 - left, end0 + right if ws < 0: we -= ws ws = 0 return ws, we

nodes.name: _attrs
nodes.body_text: def _attrs(col9: str) -> Dict[str, str]: return {k.strip(): v.strip() for k, v in _ATTR_RE.findall(col9)}

nodes.name: parse_gff3
nodes.signature: def parse_gff3(lines: Iterable[str], species_code: Optional[str] = None) -> Iterator[Gene]
nodes.body_text: def parse_gff3(lines: Iterable[str], species_code: Optional[str] = None) -> Iterator[Gene]: """Yield genes in file order. A gene is emitted when the next gene line starts or at EOF. With species_code the gene key rule applies (gene_key); without it the GFF ID (then Name) is used verbatim.""" cur: Optional[Gene] = None tx_parent: Dict[str, str] = {} counter = 0 seen_keys: set = set() for raw in lines: line = raw.rstrip("\n") if not line or line.startswith("#"): continue cols = line.split("\t") if len(cols) < 9: continue chrom, _src, ftype, s, e, _sc, strand, phase, col9 = cols[:9] a = _attrs(col9) if ftype == "gene": if cur is not None: yield cur counter += 1 gid, gname = a.get("ID", ""), a.get("Name", "") key = gene_key(species_code, gid, gname, counter) if species_code else (gid or gname or f"{chrom}:{s}-{e}") if key in seen_keys: raise ValueError(f"duplicate gene key {key} (ID={gid!r}, Name={gname!r}) at {chrom}:{s}-{e}") seen_keys.add(key) cur = Gene(key, chrom, strand, int(s) - 1, int(e), {}, gid, gname) tx_parent = {} elif ftype in ("mRNA", "transcript"): if cur is None: cur = Gene(a.get("Parent", a.get("ID", "gene")), chrom, strand, int(s) - 1, int(e)) tid = a.get("ID", f"tx{len(cur.transcripts) + 1}") tx_parent[tid] = cur.gene_id cur.transcripts.setdefault(tid, []) elif ftype in FEATURE_TYPES: if cur is None: raise ValueError(f"feature before any gene/mRNA: {line}") tid = a.get("Parent", next(iter(cur.transcripts), "tx1")) if tid not in cur.transcripts: if cur.transcripts and tid not in tx_parent: raise ValueError(f"feature {a.get('ID')} refers to transcript {tid} of another gene") cur.transcripts[tid] = [] cur.transcripts[tid].append(Feature(ftype, int(s), int(e), phase if ftype == "CDS" else ".")) if cur is not None: yield cur

nodes.name: _rel
nodes.signature: def _rel(f: Feature, ws: int) -> Tuple[str, int, int, str]
nodes.body_text: def _rel(f: Feature, ws: int) -> Tuple[str, int, int, str]: return (f.type, f.start1 - 1 - ws, f.end1 - ws, f.phase)

nodes.name: _orient
nodes.body_text: def _orient(strand: str): return (lambda x: x) if strand == "+" else (lambda x: -x)

nodes.name: _transcription_order
nodes.signature: def _transcription_order(feats: Sequence[Tuple[str, int, int, str]], strand: str)
nodes.body_text: def _transcription_order(feats: Sequence[Tuple[str, int, int, str]], strand: str): o = _orient(strand) return sorted(feats, key=lambda f: (o(f[1]), o(f[2])))

nodes.name: exons_of
nodes.signature: def exons_of(feats: Sequence[Tuple[str, int, int, str]]) -> List[Tuple[int, int]]
nodes.body_text: def exons_of(feats: Sequence[Tuple[str, int, int, str]]) -> List[Tuple[int, int]]: """Merge coordinate-contiguous features (UTR|CDS boundaries) into exons; introns are the genomic gaps between them.""" ex: List[Tuple[int, int]] = [] for f in sorted(feats, key=lambda f: (f[1], f[2])): if ex and f[1] <= ex[-1][1]: ex[-1] = (ex[-1][0], max(ex[-1][1], f[2])) else: ex.append((f[1], f[2])) return ex

nodes.name: _signature
nodes.signature: def _signature(feats: Sequence[Tuple[str, int, int, str]], strand: str)
nodes.body_text: def _signature(feats: Sequence[Tuple[str, int, int, str]], strand: str): o = _orient(strand) ordered = _transcription_order(feats, strand) exons = exons_of(feats) gaps = [(a[1], b[0]) for a, b in zip(exons, exons[1:])] # genomic introns, ascending if strand == "-": gaps = [(o(b), o(a)) for a, b in reversed(gaps)] chain = gaps span = (o(ordered[0][1]), o(ordered[-1][2])) if strand == "+" else (o(ordered[0][2]), o(ordered[-1][1])) cds = tuple((o(f[1]), o(f[2]), f[3]) for f in ordered if f[0] == "CDS") utr = tuple((f[0], o(f[1]), o(f[2])) for f in ordered if f[0] != "CDS") return (len(chain), tuple(chain), span, cds, utr), ordered

nodes.name: _serialize
nodes.signature: def _serialize(transcripts: Sequence[Sequence[Tuple[str, int, int, str]]], strand: str) -> str
nodes.body_text: def _serialize(transcripts: Sequence[Sequence[Tuple[str, int, int, str]]], strand: str) -> str: sigs = {} for feats in transcripts: if not feats: continue key, ordered = _signature(feats, strand) sigs.setdefault(key, tuple(ordered)) # identical signatures merge ordered_tx = [sigs[k] for k in sorted(sigs)] names: Dict[Tuple[str, int, int, str], str] = {} counters = {t: 0 for t in FEATURE_TYPES} for tx in ordered_tx: for f in tx: if f not in names: counters[f[0]] += 1 names[f] = f"{f[0]}{counters[f[0]]}" feature_list = sorted(names, key=lambda f: (f[1], f[2], FEATURE_TYPES.index(f[0]), f[3])) feats_str = ";".join(f"{f[1]}|{names[f]}|{f[2]}|{strand}|{_phase_letter(f)}" for f in feature_list) tx_str = ";".join("|".join(names[f] for f in tx) for tx in ordered_tx) return f"{feats_str}>{tx_str}"

nodes.name: _phase_letter
nodes.signature: def _phase_letter(f: Tuple[str, int, int, str]) -> str
nodes.body_text: def _phase_letter(f: Tuple[str, int, int, str]) -> str: if f[0] != "CDS": return "." if f[3] not in ("0", "1", "2"): raise CapError(f"CDS feature {f[1]}-{f[2]} has no phase ({f[3]!r})") return PHASE_TO_LETTER[int(f[3])]

nodes.name: gene_to_gsf
nodes.signature: def gene_to_gsf(gene: Gene, window_start: int) -> str
nodes.body_text: def gene_to_gsf(gene: Gene, window_start: int) -> str: txs = [[_rel(f, window_start) for f in feats] for feats in gene.transcripts.values()] return _serialize(txs, gene.strand)

nodes.name: _parse
nodes.body_text: def _parse(gsf: str): feats_str, _, tx_str = gsf.partition(">") feats: Dict[str, Tuple[str, int, int, str]] = {} strand = "+" strands = set() for item in feats_str.split(";"): if not item: continue s, name, e, strand, ph = item.split("|") strands.add(strand) if len(strands) > 1: raise ValueError("mixed strands in one GSF record") ftype = re.match(r"[A-Za-z_]+", name).group(0) phase = str(LETTER_TO_PHASE[ph]) if ftype == "CDS" else "." feats[name] = (ftype, int(s), int(e), phase) txs = [[feats[n] for n in t.split("|")] for t in tx_str.split(";") if t] return feats, txs, strand

nodes.name: gsf_to_gene
nodes.signature: def gsf_to_gene(gsf: str, window_start: int, chrom: str, strand: str, gene_id: str) -> Gene
nodes.body_text: def gsf_to_gene(gsf: str, window_start: int, chrom: str, strand: str, gene_id: str) -> Gene: _feats, txs, s = _parse(gsf) if s != strand: raise ValueError(f"GSF strand {s} does not match {strand}") gene = Gene(gene_id, chrom, strand, 0, 0) for i, tx in enumerate(txs, 1): gene.transcripts[f"t{i}"] = [Feature(t, rs + window_start + 1, re_ + window_start, ph) for (t, rs, re_, ph) in tx] allf = [f for tx in gene.transcripts.values() for f in tx] gene.start0 = min(f.start1 for f in allf) - 1 gene.end0 = max(f.end1 for f in allf) return gene

nodes.name: canonicalize
nodes.body_text: def canonicalize(gsf: str) -> str: _feats, txs, strand = _parse(gsf) return _serialize(txs, strand)

nodes.name: _recompute_phases
nodes.signature: def _recompute_phases(tx: Sequence[Tuple[str, int, int, str]], strand: str, initial_phase: Optional[int] = None) -> List[Tuple[str, int, int, str]]
nodes.body_text: def _recompute_phases(tx: Sequence[Tuple[str, int, int, str]], strand: str, initial_phase: Optional[int] = None) -> List[Tuple[str, int, int, str]]: """Phases 5'->3': the first CDS keeps its own phase (0 unless the model is 5'-partial), the rest follow from the coding length so far. This makes RC an involution for partial models as well.""" ordered = _transcription_order(tx, strand) out, cum, first = [], 0, True for f in ordered: if f[0] == "CDS": if first: p0 = int(f[3]) if initial_phase is None else initial_phase phase, first = p0, False cum = -p0 # p0 bases are skipped before the first complete codon else: phase = (3 - cum % 3) % 3 out.append((f[0], f[1], f[2], str(phase))) cum += f[2] - f[1] else: out.append(f) return out

nodes.name: reverse_complement
nodes.signature: def reverse_complement(gsf: str, window_len: int) -> str
nodes.body_text: def reverse_complement(gsf: str, window_len: int) -> str: _feats, txs, strand = _parse(gsf) new_strand = "-" if strand == "+" else "+" new_txs = [] for tx in txs: first_cds = next((f for f in _transcription_order(tx, strand) if f[0] == "CDS"), None) p0 = int(first_cds[3]) if first_cds else 0 mirrored = [(t, window_len - e, window_len - s, ph) for (t, s, e, ph) in tx] new_txs.append(_recompute_phases(mirrored, new_strand, initial_phase=p0)) return _serialize(new_txs, new_strand)

nodes.name: count_tokens_v2
nodes.body_text: def count_tokens_v2(gsf: str) -> int: feats_str, _, tx_str = gsf.partition(">") n = 0 for feature in feats_str.split(";"): for col in feature.split("|"): n += len(col) if col.isdigit() else 1 n += 1 # ';' (the last one becomes <txN>) n += 1 # '>' if tx_str: parts = tx_str.split(";") for j, tx in enumerate(parts): for col in tx.split("|"): n += len(col) if col.isdigit() else 1 if j < len(parts) - 1: n += 1 # <iso> return n + 2 # <s> ... </s> (the tokenizer prepends <s>; verified against tokenization_transgenic.py)

nodes.name: check_caps
nodes.signature: def check_caps(gsf: str, window_len: Optional[int] = None) -> None
nodes.body_text: def check_caps(gsf: str, window_len: Optional[int] = None) -> None: feats, txs, _ = _parse(gsf) if not txs or not any(f[0] == "CDS" for f in feats.values()): raise CapError("no CDS: a GSF label requires at least one coding transcript") if any(not any(feats[n][0] == "CDS" for n in tx) for tx in [t.split("|") for t in gsf.partition(">")[2].split(";") if t]): raise CapError("transcript without CDS") counts = {t: 0 for t in FEATURE_TYPES} for f in feats.values(): counts[f[0]] += 1 for t in FEATURE_TYPES: if counts[t] > CAPS[t]: raise CapError(f"{t} features {counts[t]} > {CAPS[t]}") if len(txs) > CAPS["transcripts"]: raise CapError(f"transcripts {len(txs)} > {CAPS['transcripts']}") n = count_tokens_v2(gsf) if n > CAPS["tokens"]: raise CapError(f"v2 tokens {n} > {CAPS['tokens']}") if window_len is not None and window_len > MAX_WINDOW: raise CapError(f"window {window_len} > {MAX_WINDOW}")

nodes.name: build_rows
nodes.signature: def build_rows(genes: Iterable[Gene], species_id: str, rc: str, split_lookup: Dict[str, str], return_rejected: bool = False)
nodes.body_text: def build_rows(genes: Iterable[Gene], species_id: str, rc: str, split_lookup: Dict[str, str], return_rejected: bool = False): if rc not in RC_MODES: raise ValueError(f"--rc must be one of {RC_MODES}, got {rc!r}") rows, rejected = [], [] for gene in genes: if gene.gene_id not in split_lookup: raise SplitError(f"{species_id}:{gene.gene_id} has no split entry") ws, we = pad_window(gene.start0, gene.end0) L = we - ws gsf = gene_to_gsf(gene, ws) try: check_caps(gsf, window_len=L) except CapError as e: rejected.append({"species_id": species_id, "gene_id": gene.gene_id, "reason": str(e)}) continue base = { "species_id": species_id, "gene_id": gene.gene_id, "chromosome": gene.chrom, "strand": gene.strand, "start": ws, "fin": we, "gsf": gsf, "is_rc": False, "split": split_lookup[gene.gene_id], "ordering_version": ORDERING_VERSION, "window_policy": WINDOW_POLICY, "build_version": BUILD_VERSION, "gsf_token_count": count_tokens_v2(gsf), "predict": None, } rows.append(base) want_rc = rc == "all" or (rc == "isoform-only" and len(gene.transcripts) >= 2) if want_rc: rgsf = reverse_complement(gsf, L) row = dict(base) row.update(is_rc=True, strand="-" if gene.strand == "+" else "+", gsf=rgsf, gsf_token_count=count_tokens_v2(rgsf)) rows.append(row) return (rows, rejected) if return_rejected else rows

nodes.name: make_split
nodes.signature: def make_split(orthogroup_of: Dict[str, str], seed: int, fractions: Tuple[float, float, float], strict_holdout: Set[str]) -> Dict[str, str]
nodes.body_text: def make_split(orthogroup_of: Dict[str, str], seed: int, fractions: Tuple[float, float, float], strict_holdout: Set[str]) -> Dict[str, str]: held_groups = {orthogroup_of[g] for g in strict_holdout if g in orthogroup_of} groups = sorted(set(orthogroup_of.values()) - held_groups) rng = random.Random(seed) rng.shuffle(groups) n = len(groups) n_train = int(round(n * fractions[0])) n_valid = int(round(n * fractions[1])) assign = {} for i, g in enumerate(groups): assign[g] = "train" if i < n_train else ("valid" if i < n_train + n_valid else "test") for g in held_groups: assign[g] = "test" return {gene: assign[grp] for gene, grp in orthogroup_of.items()}

nodes.name: validate_split
nodes.signature: def validate_split(rows: Sequence[Dict], excluded_species: Set[str] = frozenset({"Zmays"})) -> List[str]
nodes.body_text: def validate_split(rows: Sequence[Dict], excluded_species: Set[str] = frozenset({"Zmays"})) -> List[str]: v: List[str] = [] fwd = {(r["species_id"], r["gene_id"]): r["split"] for r in rows if not r.get("is_rc")} by_group: Dict[str, Set[str]] = {} for r in rows: key = (r["species_id"], r["gene_id"]) if r["species_id"] in excluded_species: v.append(f"excluded species present: {r['species_id']} {r['gene_id']}") if r.get("is_rc") and key in fwd and fwd[key] != r["split"]: v.append(f"rc row split {r['split']} != forward split {fwd[key]} for {r['gene_id']}") if r.get("strict_holdout") and r["split"] != "test": v.append(f"strict held-out gene {r['gene_id']} in split {r['split']}") if r["split"] not in ("train", "valid", "test"): v.append(f"invalid split {r['split']!r} for {r['species_id']}:{r['gene_id']}") if r.get("is_rc") and key not in fwd: v.append(f"rc row without a forward row for {r['species_id']}:{r['gene_id']}") by_group.setdefault(r["orthogroup_id"] or f"{r['species_id']}:{r['gene_id']}", set()).add(r["split"]) for grp, splits in by_group.items(): if len(splits) > 1: v.append(f"orthogroup {grp} spans splits {sorted(splits)}") return v

nodes.name: validate_evidence_roles
nodes.body_text: def validate_evidence_roles(labels: Sequence[Dict]) -> List[str]: return [f"validation-only evidence labels {l['gene_id']} in split {l['split']}" for l in labels if l.get("source_role") == "b1_validation_only" and l.get("split") in ("train", "valid")]

nodes.name: segmentation_labels
nodes.signature: def segmentation_labels(features: Sequence[Tuple[str, int, int, str]], L: int, window_start: int)
nodes.body_text: def segmentation_labels(features: Sequence[Tuple[str, int, int, str]], L: int, window_start: int): labels = [[0.0] * len(SEG_CLASSES) for _ in range(L)] weights = [[0.0] * len(SEG_CLASSES) for _ in range(L)] for ftype, s1, e1, _strand in features: for cls in _TYPE_CLASSES.get(ftype, ()): ci = _CLASS[cls] for p in range(max(0, s1 - 1 - window_start), min(L, e1 - window_start)): labels[p][ci] = 1.0 weights[p][ci] = max(weights[p][ci], 1.0) return labels, weights

nodes.name: evidence_weight
nodes.signature: def evidence_weight(source: str, n_molecules: int, genotype: str = "reference", retained_intron: bool = False, family: str = "exon") -> float
nodes.body_text: def evidence_weight(source: str, n_molecules: int, genotype: str = "reference", retained_intron: bool = False, family: str = "exon") -> float: """A18.4 weight; `family` selects the source-weight table (A20: 'junction' -> EST leads).""" if family not in ("exon", "junction"): raise ValueError(f"family must be 'exon' or 'junction', got {family!r}") if genotype not in ("reference", "non_reference", "hybrid_pooled", "unknown"): raise ValueError(f"unknown genotype stratum {genotype!r}") if n_molecules < 1: raise ValueError("evidence weight needs >= 1 independent molecule") if retained_intron: return RETAINED_INTRON_WEIGHT table = JUNCTION_SOURCE_WEIGHT if family == "junction" else SOURCE_WEIGHT if family == "junction" and source == "protein" and n_molecules < 2: raise ValueError("protein junction support needs >= 2 organisms (A19.3)") sw = table[source] * (1.0 if genotype == "reference" else 0.5) return min(WEIGHT_CAP, 1.0 + sw * math.log1p(n_molecules))

nodes.name: add_evidence
nodes.signature: def add_evidence(labels, weights, cells: Iterable[Tuple[int, int, float]]) -> None
nodes.body_text: def add_evidence(labels, weights, cells: Iterable[Tuple[int, int, float]]) -> None: """Evidence adds positives only; existing labels and weights are never lowered.""" L = len(labels) for pos, cls, w in cells: if not (0 <= pos < L) or not (0 <= cls < len(SEG_CLASSES)) or w < 0: raise ValueError(f"evidence cell out of range: pos={pos} cls={cls} w={w}") labels[pos][cls] = 1.0 weights[pos][cls] = max(weights[pos][cls], w)

nodes.name: junction_weight
nodes.signature: def junction_weight(source: str, n_molecules: int, genotype: str = "reference") -> float
nodes.body_text: def junction_weight(source: str, n_molecules: int, genotype: str = "reference") -> float: return evidence_weight(source, n_molecules, genotype, family="junction")

nodes.name: add_junction_evidence
nodes.signature: def add_junction_evidence(labels, weights, donor0: int, acceptor0: int, weight: float) -> None
nodes.body_text: def add_junction_evidence(labels, weights, donor0: int, acceptor0: int, weight: float) -> None: if not (0 <= donor0 < acceptor0 < len(labels)): raise ValueError(f"junction out of range or reversed: donor0={donor0} acceptor0={acceptor0} L={len(labels)}") d, a, i = _CLASS["splice_donor"], _CLASS["splice_acceptor"], _CLASS["intron"] cells = [(donor0, d, weight), (acceptor0, a, weight)] + [(p, i, weight) for p in range(donor0, acceptor0 + 1)] add_evidence(labels, weights, cells)

nodes.name: genes_in_window
nodes.signature: def genes_in_window(genes: Sequence[Gene], ws: int, we: int) -> Tuple[List[Gene], int]
